author: Hiring Manager
title: Technical Product Manager (EdTech)
job_description:
We are seeking a talented and experienced **Technical Product Manager** to lead the development of Whizara's EdTech platform that connects students with high quality teachers.

As a **Technical Product Manager**, you will play a pivotal role in defining the product strategy, roadmap, and feature set to create an innovative and effective learning experience for our users. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, education experts, and customer support to deliver a high-quality product that meets the needs of our users and drives business growth.

Responsibilities:

* Develop and execute a product strategy aligned with the company's overall vision, goals and business objectives
* Create and maintain a product roadmap that outlines key product features, enhancements, and milestones
* Work closely with stakeholders, including educators, learners, and internal teams, to gather and prioritize product requirements
* Remain on top of the market trends and competition to drive product strategy
* Collaborate with design teams to create intuitive and engaging user experiences that facilitate effective learning experience for students
* Oversee the selection of appropriate technologies, frameworks, and tools to build and maintain a scalable product
* Implement agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban, to drive efficient and iterative product development cycles
* Work closely with QA teams to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of the platform
* Utilize data analytics and user feedback to inform product decisions, optimize user engagement, and drive continuous improvement
* Ensure seamless integration with third-party tools and services, needed to deliver value to customers
* Stay informed about relevant regulations and standards in the US K-12 EdTech market, and ensure compliance, including data privacy and security requirements

Requirements:

* At least a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Education, or a related field
* Proven experience as a Technical Product Manager with a focus on developing software products in K-12 Education
* Conversant with US K-12 Education standards and compliances
* Strong technical background with experience in software development, web technologies, and cloud platforms
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate product vision, strategy, and requirements to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making
* Experience working in cross-functional teams in an agile development environment.
* Passion for education, technology, and improving learning outcomes through innovative software solutions

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Do you have prior experience with AI-powered EdTech product management?
* What is your availability to start/notice period?
* Are you available to work during US business hours?
* What is your current CTC (in INR)?
* What is your expected CTC (in INR)?

Experience:

* EdTech Product Management: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Description**
---------------

Role Objective: The Group Product Manager (GPM) – Marketing will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies for assigned product portfolios. The role involves market analysis, brand planning, product lifecycle management, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to drive product growth, market share, and profitability. Principal Tasks & Responsibilities Key Responsibilities 1. Brand Strategy & Planning Develop and implement marketing strategies for assigned brands/products. Prepare annual brand plans and promotional strategies aligned with business objectives. Monitor brand performance and take corrective actions to achieve targets. 2. Market Analysis Conduct market research to understand market trends, competition, and customer insights. Analyze prescription trends, sales data, and competitor activities. Identify opportunities for product growth and market expansion. 3. Product Lifecycle Management Manage product lifecycle including product launches, positioning, and growth strategies. Plan and execute new product launches in coordination with cross-functional teams. 4. Promotional Activities Design and implement promotional campaigns, marketing materials, and brand communication. Develop visual aids, promotional inputs, and digital marketing initiatives for field force effectiveness. 5. Field Force Engagement Work closely with the sales team to ensure effective product promotion. Conduct training sessions for field force on product knowledge and marketing strategies. Provide regular updates and guidance to improve field performance. 6. Stakeholder Collaboration Coordinate with Medical, Regulatory, Sales, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to ensure smooth product operations. Engage with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and healthcare professionals for brand advocacy. 7. Budget Management Manage marketing budgets and ensure cost-effective utilization. Monitor ROI of marketing activities. Key Skills & Competencies Brand growth and market share Achievement of sales targets Successful product launches Effectiveness of promotional campaigns Field force productivity and engagement

title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Chapter Lead

**Your role and responsibilities :**

The candidate will be responsible to start-up and develop new solutions in a specific product range according to the AT/AU strategy. In a global and changing context, effective leadership and market driven thinking are prerequisite for this role.

As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for the specific product range in the field of Switchgear, you will be accountable for its long-term profitable growth, by developing and managing the product range through its life cycle phases, according to market needs and AT/AU strategy. In a global and evolving market, effective leadership and market driven thinking are prerequisite for this role. Working in a brand-new Agile Organization, you will join the Agile

Team Develop Solutions:

Distribution Boards & Motor Control Centers – part of the Distribution & Energy Management Agile Unit – as a key contributor, understanding the requirements of the industry, specific channels and segments for the product release

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification Smart Power Agile in Bangalore or Hyderabad, India.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

  

* Analyzing market trends, identifying customer needs, and setting market requirements for future development.
* Managing existing solutions used in the market, leveraging in monitoring sales target fulfillment and in taking appropriate actions.
* Defining future features and services.
* Boosting market penetration in line with the AT/AU’s ambitions.

**Qualifications for the role:**

  

* Master’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering; Business Administration, Economics, or equivalent work experience also accepted.
* Previous experience in a similar field.
* Understanding of the global and local markets for Enclosure/Switchgear, with experience in product management sales, engineering, R&D, and operational projects.
* Well-developed and well-rounded communication, collaboration, structured, problem-solving, and results-oriented skills.
* Teamwork, a penchant for innovation, attention to customers and stakeholders, and high motivation are essential personal qualities.
* Ability to anticipate customer needs and market trends, driven by curiosity and motivation.

**More about us :**

ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

job_description:
This role will begin accepting applications on October 30, 2026, targeting cohort starts between April and August 2027*.* You must complete your application \*before\* end of day on November 24, 2026 to be considered. Thank you in advance for your patience while our team reviews all applications. All applicants will be notified by the end of Spring 2027 with an update.

* + In the “Resume" section, attach an updated CV or resume. No cover letter needed.
  + In the “Higher education" section, fill out the fields accordingly and select “Now attending or Graduated” under "Degree status." Then, upload a current or recent unofficial or official transcript in English.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Currently enrolled in or graduated from a degree program within Product Management, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Internship or Teaching Assistant experience in product management, software development or a similar technical field.
* Experience leading entrepreneurial efforts or outreach within organizations while building cross-functional relationships.
* Experience preparing and delivering technical presentations to an audience through internships, coursework, or extracurriculars.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with methodologies aimed to drive product development and delivery.
* Experience applying Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) concepts to build products or features through relevant internship, capstone projects, or other academic work.
* Technical experience with programming languages, data analysis, business case/modeling, pricing, or design.
* Ability to start full-time in the primary cohort onboarding cycle between April and August 2027.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support cross-functional business relationships in the region.
* Excellent problem-solving, organizational, investigative, and critical thinking skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google aims to build products that organize the world's information and make it universally accessible to our users. As a Product Manager at Google, you could be working on new technologies, platforms, consumer facing products, and/or enterprise systems. The end goal will be to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, experience, and where you will have the most impact.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Understand markets and user requirements in depth.
* Launch products and features, test their performance, and iterate quickly.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and User Experience (UX) on technologies.
* Develop innovative solutions to problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
LotusFlare is a provider of cloud-native SaaS products based in the heart of Silicon Valley. Founded by the team that helped Facebook reach over one billion users, LotusFlare was founded to make affordable mobile communications available to everyone on Earth.

Today, LotusFlare focuses on designing, building, and continuously evolving a digital commerce and monetization platform that delivers valuable outcomes for enterprises. Our platform, Digital Network Operator (DNO) Cloud, is licensed to telecommunications services providers and supports millions of customers globally.

LotusFlare has also designed and built the leading eSIM travel product - Nomad. Nomad provides global travelers with high-speed, affordable data connectivity in over 190 countries. Nomad is available as an iOS or Android app or via getnomad.app.  
  
**Job Description and Responsibilities:**  
You will own the platform that helps our sales and marketing teams bring LotusFlare to life for CSPs, showing what our technology can do in the context of each customer's business. It is also a place to build and try new ideas that are not yet part of the core product, so we can learn what excites the market before we commit to them. You will report to the director of product and lead a team of four engineers.

What success looks like in the first year

* Sales and marketing can set up a tailored demo themselves, with far less engineering time per demo than today.
* Booth and call demos run reliably, with problems found before the client sees them.
* A working experiment track: ideas come in, get tested, and at least some graduate to the core roadmap or are retired with a clear reason.
* The four-person team delivers predictably, and sales and marketing trust the roadmap.

Responsibilities:

Discovery and roadmap: You turn what sales and marketing need into a prioritized roadmap and tickets the engineers can build from.

* Talk regularly with sales, pre-sales and marketing to learn demo pain points, upcoming client needs and conference plans.
* Balance two kinds of demos: live sales-call demos tailored to a specific CSP, and booth demos that must run reliably and with little supervision.
* Check each demo request against current DNO capabilities and decide what belongs on the platform roadmap, what is a one-off, and what is a request to the core product team.
* Write clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Create the demo process, user guides and training that drive adoption by non-technical users.

Experimental features: You run the part of the platform where we develop and host features that are not yet part of the core product, and test them before they reach it.

* Set up how experiments are proposed, selected and scoped, and keep them small enough to ship quickly.
* Define up front what each experiment must show, such as client reaction in demos, conference interest or sales feedback.
* Decide, with the evidence, whether an experiment graduates to the core product roadmap, continues, or is retired.
* Hand graduating features to the core product team with the context they need.
* Keep experiments clearly labeled so sales never presents an unreleased feature as available.

Technical partnership and demo quality: You work alongside engineering and do not own architecture decisions alone; you bring the product context and the tradeoffs.

* Work with the engineering lead and backend teams on API integrations and data flows between the platform and DNO systems.
* Define requirements for how AI tools and agents set up demo environments, generate demo data and build demo experiences, so sales can prepare demos with minimal engineering support.
* Take part in architecture discussions, understand the tradeoffs, and help the team make decisions.
* Work with engineering to keep demo environments, data and key journeys stable, with automated tests where they pay off, so every demo is client-ready.

Leading the team and delivery

* Lead a team of four engineers: set priorities, give feedback and support their growth.
* Run sprint planning, backlog refinement and retrospectives, using Scrum or Kanban as fits the team.
* Own delivery of features from requirements through to production release.
* Track dependencies on other teams, flag risks early and keep stakeholders informed of timelines.
* Report progress and results to leadership in plain, non-technical terms.  
    
  **Job Requirements:**  
  4+ years of product management experience, ideally with B2B SaaS or platform products.
* Experience owning features or a product from discovery through delivery.
* Experience working with sales, pre-sales or marketing teams as users or stakeholders.
* Comfortable working daily with engineers and writing clear tickets and acceptance criteria.
* Working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
* Hands-on use of AI tools in your own work, and the ability to prototype ideas quickly.
* Experience running sprint ceremonies for an engineering team.
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.
* Experience leading or mentoring people is a plus; if you have not managed engineers before, tell us how you have led without authority.

**Nice to have**

* Telecom or digital BSS domain knowledge.
* Experience building products for internal users.
* Familiarity with AI agents and MCP servers.
* Experience with demo tooling or conference and event demos.  
    
  **Benefits we have for you:**  
  + Competitive salary package
  + Paid lunch (In the office)
  + Private healthcare
  + Yearly bonus
  + Training and workshops
  + Truly flexible working hours
  + Top-of-the-class engineers to learn from and work with  
  **About us:**  
  At LotusFlare, we attract and keep amazing people by offering two key things:  
  + Purposeful Work: Every team member sees how their efforts make a tangible, positive difference for our customers and partners.
  + Growth Opportunities: We provide the chance to develop professionally while mastering cutting-edge practices in cloud-native enterprise software.  
  From the beginning, our mission has been to simplify technology to create better experiences for customers. Using an “experience down” approach, which prioritizes the customer's journey at every stage of development, our Digital Network Operator Cloud empowers communication service providers to achieve valuable business outcomes. DNO Cloud enables communication service providers to innovate freely, reduce operational costs, monetize network assets, engage customers on all digital channels, drive customer acquisition, and increase retention.  
    
  With headquarters in Santa Clara, California, and five major offices worldwide, LotusFlare serves Deutsche Telekom, T-Mobile, A1, Globe Telecom, Liberty Latin America, Singtel, and other leading enterprises around the world.  
    
  Website: www.lotusflare.com  
  LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/lotusflare  
  Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lifeatlotusflare/
    
  Twitter: https://twitter.com/lotus\_flare

* Define requirements for how AI tools and agents set up demo environments, generate demo data and build demo experiences, so sales can prepare demos with minimal engineering support.
* Take part in architecture discussions, understand the tradeoffs, and help the team make decisions.
* Work with engineering to keep demo environments, data and key journeys stable, with automated tests where they pay off, so every demo is client-ready.

Leading the team and delivery

* Lead a team of four engineers: set priorities, give feedback and support their growth.
* Run sprint planning, backlog refinement and retrospectives, using Scrum or Kanban as fits the team.
* Own delivery of features from requirements through to production release.
* Track dependencies on other teams, flag risks early and keep stakeholders informed of timelines.
* Report progress and results to leadership in plain, non-technical terms.  
    
  **Job Requirements:**  
  4+ years of product management experience, ideally with B2B SaaS or platform products.
* Experience owning features or a product from discovery through delivery.
* Experience working with sales, pre-sales or marketing teams as users or stakeholders.
* Comfortable working daily with engineers and writing clear tickets and acceptance criteria.
* Working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
* Hands-on use of AI tools in your own work, and the ability to prototype ideas quickly.
* Experience running sprint ceremonies for an engineering team.
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.
* Experience leading or mentoring people is a plus; if you have not managed engineers before, tell us how you have led without authority.

**Nice to have**

* Telecom or digital BSS domain knowledge.
* Experience building products for internal users.
* Familiarity with AI agents and MCP servers.
* Experience with demo tooling or conference and event demos.  
    
  **Benefits we have for you:**  
  + Competitive salary package
  + Paid lunch (In the office)
  + Private healthcare
  + Yearly bonus
  + Training and workshops
  + Truly flexible working hours
  + Top-of-the-class engineers to learn from and work with  
  **About us:**  
  At LotusFlare, we attract and keep amazing people by offering two key things:  
  + Purposeful Work: Every team member sees how their efforts make a tangible, positive difference for our customers and partners.
  + Growth Opportunities: We provide the chance to develop professionally while mastering cutting-edge practices in cloud-native enterprise software.  
  From the beginning, our mission has been to simplify technology to create better experiences for customers. Using an “experience down” approach, which prioritizes the customer's journey at every stage of development, our Digital Network Operator Cloud empowers communication service providers to achieve valuable business outcomes. DNO Cloud enables communication service providers to innovate freely, reduce operational costs, monetize network assets, engage customers on all digital channels, drive customer acquisition, and increase retention.  
    
  With headquarters in Santa Clara, California, and five major offices worldwide, LotusFlare serves Deutsche Telekom, T-Mobile, A1, Globe Telecom, Liberty Latin America, Singtel, and other leading enterprises around the world.

  Twitter: https://twitter.com/lotus\_flare

Role - Senior Product Manager || Job Location - Bangalore
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Product Manager / Senior Product Manager – AI to lead the strategy, development, and implementation of AI-driven products that transform customer and merchant experiences across our payments ecosystem. The role will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, and Business teams to develop next-generation solutions powered by large language models (LLMs) and other generative AI technologies.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Define and drive the roadmap for generative AI capabilities across our product suite, including fraud detection, customer support automation, and personalised payment experiences.
  
Work cross-functionally with AI/ML Engineers, Data Scientists, UX Designers, and business stakeholders to build, launch, and iterate on AI-powered features.
  
Identify customer pain points and develop AI-first product solutions that improve efficiency, security, and user engagement.
  
Evaluate third-party LLM platforms, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, and work with internal teams to integrate them securely and effectively.
  
Monitor product performance using data and customer feedback, and use insights to optimise AI models and user interactions.
  
Ensure that all AI product developments comply with applicable financial regulations and data privacy laws, including RBI and GDPR requirements.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
3–5 years of product management experience, including at least 1+ year of experience in AI products; experience in payments or fintech is highly preferred.
  
Strong understanding of generative AI models, including LLMs, transformers, and embeddings, and their applications in real-world products.
  
Proven track record of shipping B2C or B2B AI/ML-driven products at scale.
  
Strong analytical, strategic-thinking, and communication skills.
  
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with regulatory sensitivity.
  
  
Nice to Have
  
  
Experience with prompt engineering and fine-tuning LLMs.
  
Background in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Software Engineering.
  
Familiarity with payment ecosystems, risk modelling, and fraud analytics.
  
  
About PayU
  
  
At PayU, we’re building a world without financial borders where everyone can prosper. As a global fintech investor operating in 18+ high-growth markets, we extend financial services to underserved populations, help merchants thrive online, and invest in innovative financial technology. As part of Prosus, one of the world’s largest technology investors, we combine global expertise with local market knowledge to create meaningful impact. Learn more at www.payu.com
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion
  
  
PayU fosters an environment where everyone belongs regardless of gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, or religious belief. Our leadership is committed to creating a transparent, flexible workplace where every voice matters and all PayUneers can succeed. We have zero tolerance for discrimination and actively promote equal opportunities across our global organization.

title: Product Manager, Enterprise Solutions
job_description:
As a Product Manager in the APAC Products' cross-functional team, you will work on enabling AI-powered experiences for Enterprise customers, helping businesses transform how they engage with their audiences through intelligent solutions. This role is strategically important as you will shape the future of AI-enabled enterprise products in India/APAC. You will define new models for building, launching, and scaling AI-driven solutions that help enterprises automate workflows, personalize customer interactions, and unlock new business opportunities. You will partner with engineering, design, data science, and business teams to deliver meaningful AI-powered product experiences for enterprise clients. The team operates with close proximity to APAC markets, fostering strong partnerships. Expect a collaborative, people-centered environment with experienced teammates who value mentorship and knowledge sharing.This position offers a opportunity to shape AI-enabled enterprise products at global scale while being rooted in one of the world's most dynamic regions. If you're excited by bringing cutting-edge AI capabilities to enterprise customers and driving real business transformation, you'll thrive here.  
  
  

### **Product Manager, Enterprise Solutions Responsibilities:**

* Define and execute product roadmaps for AI-enabled enterprise experiences, including automation tools, intelligent workflows, and personalization capabilities
* Identify and drive consensus for how to prioritize and realize the most significant opportunities in your product area
* Lead cross-functional collaboration across engineering, design, data science, sales, and partnerships to deliver integrated solutions
* Drive go-to-market strategy for enterprise AI products in APAC markets, with potential for global expansion
* Scale AI best practices (including responsible AI use), workflows, and artifacts across product teams so the organization's capabilities compound over time
* Support the growth of other PMs and cross-functional team members by providing mentorship and coaching on AI-native practices
* Communicate product strategy and progress clearly and consistently to all stakeholders

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of Product Management experience
* 3+ years experience leading AI/ML product initiatives at scale (enterprise or B2B preferred)
* APAC market experience, as the role supports enterprise product strategy and go-to-market efforts across APAC markets
* Track record shipping products that drove measurable business outcomes for enterprise customers
* Experience developing and scaling AI-native strategies including evals and data strategies across teams
* Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder environments and influencing without authority

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Senior Product Manager, Payer Content Solutions and Analytics
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and execution of payer content solutions and supporting reporting and analytics capabilities. This role will be responsible for driving API-based content products that help healthcare payer and provider organizations improve operational efficiency, reduce denials, lower administrative costs, and enhance customer experiences.

The ideal candidate combines solid product management expertise with deep healthcare domain knowledge, particularly within claims, benefits, prior authorization, policy management, and revenue cycle operations. This individual will work cross-functionally with engineering, operations, clinical, sales, and client-facing teams to deliver innovative, market-ready solutions that produce measurable business outcomes.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product Strategy and Roadmap
  + Define and execute product strategy for payer content solutions and associated reporting and analytics capabilities
  + Develop and maintain product roadmaps aligned to business objectives, market opportunities, customer needs, and measurable outcomes
  + Identify opportunities to improve denial reduction, cost savings, call deflection, and operational efficiency through innovative content and analytics solutions
* Product Development and Delivery
  + Translate payer and provider business challenges into scalable API content products, reporting capabilities, and actionable product requirements
  + Partner with engineering, operations, and other stakeholders to define features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements
  + Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation through Alpha, Beta, and General Availability (GA) releases
  + Define MVP scope, prioritize product backlogs, and ensure successful execution using Agile methodologies and product management tools
* Customer and Market Engagement
  + Collaborate with payer and provider clients to identify business needs, validate use cases, and gather product feedback
  + Ensure product capabilities align with real-world healthcare workflows, systems, and operational requirements
  + Conduct market and competitive research to identify emerging trends and opportunities within healthcare content, API-driven solutions, and analytics
* Cross-Functional Leadership
  + Drive alignment across product, engineering, operations, clinical, delivery, and go-to-market teams
  + Provide regular updates to executive leadership and key stakeholders on product performance, roadmap progress, and delivery milestones
  + Coordinate product readiness activities to support successful launches and customer adoption
* Product Enablement and Support
  + Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for payer content solutions and analytics products
  + Support the development of customer-facing and internal product documentation, training materials, and support resources
  + Partner with sales and marketing teams to strengthen product positioning, sales enablement, and go-to-market activities
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of product management experience with ownership of complex enterprise software or platform products
* Experience developing and managing healthcare technology products, preferably within payer, provider, revenue cycle, or healthcare operations environments
* Demonstrated experience with API-based products, content sourcing strategies, or platform-based solutions
* Experience defining product use cases and working closely with engineering teams to deliver scalable product capabilities
* Experience with reporting and analytics platforms, including performance measurement, KPI development, and operational reporting
* Solid understanding of Agile product development methodologies and tools such as Rally, Aha!, Jira, or similar platforms
* Proven excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with healthcare content products, claims intelligence, policy content, pricing transparency, or related healthcare information services
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale healthcare platforms serving multiple customer segments
* Deep knowledge of payer and provider operations, including:
  + Claims processing
  + Benefits management
  + Prior authorization
  + Policy and editing logic
  + Revenue cycle management
  + Denial management
  + Call center operations
* Familiarity with emerging AI, automation, and agentic workflow solutions within healthcare technology

**Key Success Factors**

* The successful candidate will demonstrate:
* Solid product management leadership and execution
* Subject matter expertise in healthcare claims content and payer/provider workflows
* Ability to translate complex healthcare operational challenges into customer-focused product solutions
* Experience leveraging reporting and analytics data to drive product decisions, measure outcomes, and optimize performance
* Proven success working across diverse stakeholders to deliver high-impact products that drive business growth and customer value

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

You are a product leader who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution You have a deep understanding of healthcare claims and payer/provider operations, excel at transforming market needs into scalable product capabilities, and are passionate about using data, analytics, APIs, and emerging technologies to solve complex healthcare challenges.

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Lead Technical Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

Are you passionate about building secure, scalable, and automated cloud networking solutions at enterprise scale? As a **Senior Technical Product Manager** within Optum's Public Cloud organization, you will play a pivotal role in driving the evolution of our multi-cloud networking capabilities across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform.

In this role, you will partner with engineering teams, cloud architects, security leaders, and application teams to modernize networking experiences that accelerate cloud adoption while ensuring compliance, reliability, and operational excellence. You will help define requirements, drive prioritization, and execute strategic networking initiatives that enable thousands of developers and hundreds of cloud workloads across the enterprise.

This role is ideal for an experienced technical product manager who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, influencing cross-functional teams, and delivering products that simplify cloud networking for application teams.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Product Ownership and Strategy (20%)**

* Own and drive specific cloud networking product areas within the Public Cloud portfolio, including connectivity, ingress/egress, service networking, network security, traffic management, DNS, and hybrid cloud networking
* Partner with senior product leadership to define vision, roadmap priorities, and quarterly objectives for networking capabilities
* Work closely with application teams to understand networking challenges, onboarding friction points, and operational pain points
* Identify opportunities to improve automation, self-service experiences, scalability, and developer productivity
* Translate business and technical requirements into product roadmaps and delivery plans

**Execution and Delivery (60%)**

* Manage and prioritize networking product backlogs across multiple engineering teams
* Define detailed product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics
* Lead delivery of cloud networking initiatives spanning Azure, AWS, and GCP environments
* Drive improvements in cloud onboarding, network provisioning, firewall automation, service connectivity, and developer enablement workflows
* Coordinate delivery dependencies across engineering, security, compliance, infrastructure, and operations teams
* Monitor product health, adoption metrics, reliability measures, and customer satisfaction indicators
* Support release planning, testing, rollout strategies, and operational readiness activities
* Drive issue resolution and continuous improvement initiatives through customer feedback and operational insights

**Stakeholder Management and Collaboration (20%)**

* Serve as a trusted partner to engineering managers, architects, security teams, and application stakeholders
* Facilitate alignment across multiple teams with competing priorities and objectives
* Communicate roadmap progress, delivery updates, risks, dependencies, and business outcomes to leadership
* Support portfolio-level planning, quarterly business reviews, and strategic initiatives
* Champion customer-focused product development and data-driven decision making

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any directives that may arise as business needs evolve. The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion.

**Required Qualifications (8-12 + Yrs ) : -**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of product management experience with technical infrastructure, cloud platform, networking, or enterprise technology products
* 3+ years of experience working with public cloud technologies including Azure, AWS, and/or GCP
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals including routing, DNS, load balancing, firewalls, private connectivity, VPNs, and hybrid networking
* Experience working with cloud-native networking services such as Azure Virtual Network, AWS VPC, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, Cloud DNS, Azure DNS, Application Gateway, Load Balancers, and related technologies
* Experience collaborating with engineering teams using Agile methodologies including Scrum and Kanban
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear product requirements and customer value propositions
* Proven ability to prioritize competing demands and successfully deliver complex initiatives
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision making
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to technical and business stakeholders

**Core Competencies : -**

* **Technical Acumen** :Deep understanding of cloud networking architectures, connectivity patterns, security controls, and infrastructure automation.
* **Customer Focus** : Demonstrated ability to understand application team needs and translate feedback into product improvements.
* **Execution Excellence**: Strong track record of delivering complex infrastructure or platform capabilities at scale.
* **Collaboration and Influence** : Ability to drive alignment across engineering, security, operations, and business stakeholders without direct authority.
* **Strategic Thinking** : Capable of connecting day-to-day product execution with broader platform and business objectives.
* **Data-Driven Decision Making** : Experience using adoption metrics, operational KPIs, and customer feedback to guide priorities and measure success.

**Preferred Qualifications -**

* Experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or ARM/Bicep
* Experience with Kubernetes networking concepts and container platforms
* Understanding of Zero Trust networking principles and cloud security architecture
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise cloud transformations
* Familiarity with developer platforms, self-service infrastructure, and platform engineering practices
* AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, or networking certifications

**Overview:** We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to join our team as a Product Manager in the Core HCM domain . In this role, you will be responsible for leading initiatives to streamline and improve Global HR processes, ultim ately enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and employee experience across the organization in line with company policies and compliance.

**About this role:**

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Product Manager with deep expertise in Workday Core HCM to join the People Platforms team. In this role, you will own the product strategy and continuous improvement of our Core HCM capabilities across the Hire to Retire process (excluding the Hire process, which sits with the Talent Acquisition & Attraction (TAA) team), with particularly strong focus on the Change Job business process, as well as Termination and data management. You will also need working knowledge of Workday security and integrations to understand how changes in this space ripple across the wider Workday landscape. This is a strategic, solution-oriented position where you will collaborate with global leaders and cross-functional teams—including process owners, technology, security, and support functions—to accelerate implementation timelines, manage the product lifecycle, reduce operational issues, apply prioritization frameworks, and build a transparent, high-quality product roadmap.

The role is weighted roughly 50–70% product management and 50–30% process ownership; in practice the two are heavily intertwined, and the successful candidate will move fluidly between defining what we build and defining and standardizing how the underlying HR processes work.

**Key responsibilities**

**Product**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Define and execute a strategic product roadmap for Workday Core HCM aligned with organizational goals and evolving market needs, with a strong emphasis on the Change Job business process, Termination, and data management across the Hire to Retire lifecycle (excluding Hire, owned by TAA).

Feature Prioritization & Backlog Management

* Collaborate with process owners, technical teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and user feedback; own and groom the product backlog in Jira (or equivalent).

Requirements & Development Oversight

* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, well-crafted user stories, and acceptance criteria. Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle using agile methodologies, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Quality Assurance & Testing

* Partner with solution and QA teams to define test strategies—particularly for Change Job, Termination, and other core data change scenarios—and support testing efforts to ensure the reliability and performance of product releases.

Stakeholder Engagement & Product Evangelism

* Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for your products. Communicate the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition to stakeholders and end-users.

User-Centric Design & Feedback Loops

* Engage with users to gather insights, validate solutions, and drive continuous improvement through iterative feedback and data-driven decision-making.

Training & Change Enablement

* Collaborate with change management teams to develop training materials, user guides, and communication plans that support adoption and maximize product value.

Security & Integrations Awareness

* Work with security and integration teams to understand the downstream and upstream impact of Core HCM changes (e.g., Change Job, Termination, data changes) on business process security, access, and integrations, ensuring product decisions account for these implications.

**Process**

Process Design & Documentation

* Conduct comprehensive assessments of current Hire to Retire processes (excluding Hire), particularly Change Job, Termination, and related data management workflows, to identify areas for improvement and optimization.

* Develop, implement, and maintain process documentation and guidelines, ensuring these are scalable and adaptable across regions and business units, and are clearly reflected in the supporting Workday configuration.

Process Standardization

* Develop and maintain global standards for Change Job, Termination, and data management processes to enable consistency and compliance across all regions.

* Conduct regular checks to identify variances and areas for optimization, and facilitate the sharing of best practices across regions.

Process Simplification & Automation

* Use data-driven insight (including process mining where available) to identify complex, redundant, or unnecessary steps in Change Job, Termination, and data management processes, and redesign them to remove bottlenecks and reduce errors.

* Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and evaluate technology solutions that streamline processes and enhance the employee and HR user experience.

Continuous Improvement

* Implement continuous improvement initiatives—drawing on methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen where relevant—and define metrics and KPIs to measure process performance and track progress.

Change Management & Compliance

* Lead process change management activities tied to product releases, including training, documentation, and progress monitoring.

* Ensure Change Job, Termination, and data management processes comply with relevant data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements; support audits and help implement corrective actions where gaps are identified .

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (preferred).

* Minimum 7 years of experience as a Digital or Software Product Manager and/or Process Owner in the HR Technology domain.

* Deep, hands-on expertise in Workday Core HCM, with demonstrated strong expertise in the Change Job business process specifically; solid working knowledge of Termination and data management processes.

* Broad working knowledge of Workday more generally, with the ability to understand how Core HCM changes interact with other modules.

* Working knowledge of Workday security (e.g., domain and business process security) and integrations, sufficient to identify downstream impacts and collaborate effectively with specialist teams.

* Strong understanding of HR processes and systems in large, global, and matrixed organizations, including the wider Hire to Retire lifecycle.

* Strong experience working with agile methodologies and tools such as Jira (or similar), including facilitating agile ceremonies (e.g., stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives).

* Demonstrated strength in crafting clear, well-structured user stories and acceptance criteria.

* Experience in process design, standardization, and continuous improvement; familiarity with methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen is a plus.

* Demonstrated ability to develop business cases for automation and process improvements.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.

* Experience working with industrial or frontline organizations (e.g., retail, manufacturing, logistics ) is a plus.

* Passion for innovation and driving meaningful change in the HR tech landscape.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com .

**Company Description**

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few.

Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site (experian.com/careers) to understand why.

 **Job Description**

This role will support the experience of our flagship fraud platform – Ascend Fraud – supporting hundreds of clients, including the largest financial institutions in the world.

This is an ideal opportunity for a Product Manager with expertise in identity verification, analytics, fraud detection, and / or AI-driven decisioning. The successful candidate will be an AI-native product manager and own product responsibility for the Ascend Fraud platform user experience— from strategy and discovery through roadmap execution, delivery, and market adoption — while unlocking market opportunities, platform synergies, and a clear path for migration to new services.

**Product Strategy & Globalization**

* Work alongside regional stakeholders to drive roadmap and ensure Ascend Fraud (CrossCore) experience and platform priorities support regional goals
* Drive future-state requirements, feature parity, and long-term migration plans in line with the long term Ascend Fraud and Ascend platform strategy

**Product Discovery & Customer Insights**

* Work with customers and regional stakeholders to understand and address fraud and identity challenges across use cases
* Translate insights and usage data into product features that address clients' jobs-to-be-done

**Roadmap Execution**

* Own and deliver a roadmap for Ascend Fraud solutions across regions, with
* "full-stack" accountability from requirements through release for the client-facing user experience, including UI
* Using AI-DLC processes and tools, create standardized features, capabilities and reusable components

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Collaborate with globally distributed teams across Product, Engineering, Architecture, and Delivery
* Work closely with global and regional teams to ensure alignment with strategic priorities
* You will be reporting to the VP of Product Managemnt

  
**Qualifications**  

* 5+ years of Product Manager and/or Product Owner experience in complex, matrixed organizations,

* Prior ownership of B2B user experience, including UI in SaaS environment
* Domain expertise in Identity Verification, Fraud Detection, or Risk platforms
* Experience contributing to globally distributed products and platforms
* Drive product work in a geographically distributed environment
* Experience in AI-DLC environments and use of AI tools to drive feature collaboration and accelerated product and value delivery

  
**Additional Information**

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, collaboration, wellness, reward & recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's people first approach is award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2024 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, and Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2024 to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site and Glassdoor to understand why.

Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Recruitment Fraud Awareness - Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.

Benefits

Experian care for employee's work life balance, health, safety and wellbeing. In support of this endeavor, we offer best-in-class family well-being benefits, enhanced medical benefits and paid time off.

Experian Careers - Creating a better tomorrow together

**Job Information**
-------------------

* Date Opened 27/10/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Technology
* Work Experience 2-4 years
* City Noida
* Province Uttar Pradesh
* Country India
* Postal Code 201301

**Job Description**
-------------------

As a **Product Manager** at Rezo, you will own the complete product lifecycle: from understanding user needs and writing PRDs to managing design and development, launching features, and driving adoption. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who understands internal workflows and is equally comfortable building external modules that customers interact with directly. This is a high-impact role focused on delivering exceptional experiences for enterprise clients while enabling internal teams—from Sales to Analytics—to operate efficiently and at scale.

  

**Key responsibilities:**

• Product Strategy & Execution

- Define and manage the roadmap for customer-facing modules and internal tools that support delivery and operations.

- Translate business goals and user needs into structured product features and intuitive user journeys.

- Prioritize features based on impact, dependencies, and stakeholder feedback.

  

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Gather inputs and drive alignment across teams such as Sales, Project Delivery, Legal, Infra, Customer Success, and Analytics.

- Partner with Engineering to deliver high-quality features on time.

  

• User-Centered Development

- Conduct deep discovery with internal stakeholders and enterprise customers to identify pain points.

- Write detailed PRDs with clear workflows, success criteria, and edge cases.

- Create wireframes or collaborate with the design team to bring concepts to life.

  

• Platform Thinking

- Build scalable systems that work across geographies, teams, and industries.

- Establish feedback loops to continuously evolve internal and external tools.

  

• Analytics & Quality

- Monitor platform metrics, customer behavior, and operational performance to identify improvement areas.

- Collaborate with analytics teams to track adoption, identify friction points, and recommend interventions.

  

### **Requirements**

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, Computer Science, or related field.

  

Experience

* 2–4 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, preferably across platforms, internal tools, and customer-facing products.

  

Functional Skills
  
- Proven ability to write high-quality PRDs and lead cross-functional teams.

- Strong systems thinking with experience designing tools that enhance operational productivity.

- Exposure to customer lifecycle workflows, data dashboards, or service automation is a plus.

- Proficiency in JIRA, Figma, Confluence, or similar tools.

  

Behavioral Skills & Attitude

- Customer-Centric Mindset – Prioritizes customer satisfaction and proactive engagement.

- Proactive Approach – Anticipates issues and takes ownership to resolve them.

- Communication Skills – Communicates clearly and persuasively with stakeholders.

- Interpersonal Skills – Builds strong relationships and fosters trust.

**Key responsibilities:**

• Product Strategy & Execution

- Define and manage the roadmap for customer-facing modules and internal tools that support delivery and operations.

- Translate business goals and user needs into structured product features and intuitive user journeys.

- Prioritize features based on impact, dependencies, and stakeholder feedback.

  

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Gather inputs and drive alignment across teams such as Sales, Project Delivery, Legal, Infra, Customer Success, and Analytics.

- Partner with Engineering to deliver high-quality features on time.

  

• User-Centered Development

- Conduct deep discovery with internal stakeholders and enterprise customers to identify pain points.

- Write detailed PRDs with clear workflows, success criteria, and edge cases.

- Create wireframes or collaborate with the design team to bring concepts to life.

  

• Platform Thinking

- Build scalable systems that work across geographies, teams, and industries.

- Establish feedback loops to continuously evolve internal and external tools.

  

• Analytics & Quality

- Monitor platform metrics, customer behavior, and operational performance to identify improvement areas.

- Collaborate with analytics teams to track adoption, identify friction points, and recommend interventions.

  

### **Requirements**

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, Computer Science, or related field.

  

Experience

* 2–4 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, preferably across platforms, internal tools, and customer-facing products.

  

Functional Skills
  
- Proven ability to write high-quality PRDs and lead cross-functional teams.

- Strong systems thinking with experience designing tools that enhance operational productivity.

- Exposure to customer lifecycle workflows, data dashboards, or service automation is a plus.

- Proficiency in JIRA, Figma, Confluence, or similar tools.

  

Behavioral Skills & Attitude

- Customer-Centric Mindset – Prioritizes customer satisfaction and proactive engagement.

- Proactive Approach – Anticipates issues and takes ownership to resolve them.

- Communication Skills – Communicates clearly and persuasively with stakeholders.

- Interpersonal Skills – Builds strong relationships and fosters trust.

title: Senior Staff Product Manager - AI Agents (Migration & Onboarding)
job_description:
**Overview**
------------

Come join the QuickBooks Desktop team (part of Mid-Market Segment) as a Senior Staff Product Manager, AI Migration & Onboarding Agent.

QuickBooks is Intuit's flagship accounting software, powering millions of small and mid-sized businesses globally. The Mid-Market team is driving a critical transformation: migrating customers from Desktop to cloud-native platforms.

Today, migration from desktop to cloud is high-friction and high-touch. It slows conversion and strains support capacity. Your mission is to change that by building an AI Agent that guides customers through the entire migration journey, from readiness assessment to data migration, configuration, and first productive use.

This is a zero-to-one role. You will own the vision, strategy, and execution for this agent, working at the intersection of LLMs, agentic architectures, and accounting domain knowledge to turn migration from a barrier into a growth engine.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the AI Migration Agent end-to-end: Define vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI agent that guides customers through complex product migrations, from readiness assessment through post-migration validation.
* Design for scalability and reuse: Architect the agent as a modular platform capability that can be extended to multiple source systems, customer segments, and net-new onboarding journeys.
* Define AI/Human collaboration: Design patterns where the agent handles routine tasks autonomously and escalates complex decisions to domain experts, support teams, or customers.
* Build the knowledge backbone: Own the agent's knowledge base, including product mapping logic, feature parity data, gap analysis rules, and domain-specific reasoning.
* Drive adoption and migration velocity: Define success metrics (completion rate, time-to-value, CSAT, support deflection) and build feedback loops to continuously improve agent performance.
* Lead cross-functional execution: Align engineering, AI/ML, design, data science, sales, care, and operations around an agent-first migration strategy. Partner with platform teams to leverage shared AI infrastructure.
* Close the customer insight loop: Research migrating customers, domain experts, and internal teams to uncover friction points and benchmark against AI-driven migration experiences in SaaS and Fintech.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years in product management with 2+ years shipping AI agent, conversational AI, or intelligent automation products in B2B SaaS or Fintech.
* AI Agent expertise: Deep understanding of agentic architectures, LLMs, RAG systems, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation pipelines. Experience defining guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human-in-the-loop escalation patterns.
* B2B SaaS Migration experience: Track record building customer migration, data portability, or onboarding products. Understands the complexity of moving business-critical data between systems at scale.
* Platform thinking: Designs modular, reusable agent capabilities that serve multiple source systems, customer segments, and journey types.
* Customer empathy: Deep experience with SMB/mid-market customers. Understands the friction and anxiety customers face when switching business-critical software.
* Analytical rigor: Comfortable defining and tracking agent performance metrics like accuracy, task completion, escalation rate, and time-to-value.
* Cross-functional influence: Proven ability to align engineering, AI/ML, design, and GTM teams around a shared product vision in a matrixed organization.
* Education: Undergraduate degree required (technical discipline preferred). MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Preferred

* Hands-on experience with LLM-based agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and AI evaluation techniques.
* Experience in accounting, ERP, or financial software domains.
* Top-Tier or International MBA or other Advanced degree preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

job_description:
**Date de publication :** Oct 29, 2026, 12:00AM
  
Join us at Orange Business!
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**Role Overview:**  
We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Lead Product Owner / Product Manager to lead the development and enhancement of our flagship commercial ordering platform in international perimeter . The ideal candidate will drive product vision, prioritize features,perform requirement analysis and ensure seamless delivery to meet business needs and improve user experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Define and prioritize the product backlog aligning with business goals.
* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, sales, and technical teams.
* Oversee end-to-end product lifecycle, including feature development, releases, and updates.
* Gather and analyze user feedback, market trends, and business requirements to inform product roadmap.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product manager
job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**About the Team & Role**

Expedia Group’s Payments team is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the traveler payment experience, covering how travelers discover, select, and use payment methods at checkout. You’ll set strategy, prioritization, and experimentation for payment selection, flexibility, authorization performance, and recovery across web, mobile web, and native apps. The role blends deep payments expertise with AI product judgment to make payments simple, transparent, and trusted at global scale. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, and brand teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

  

* Define and execute the product vision and roadmap for payment selection, payment method presentation, payment flexibility, and checkout interactions.
* Own the payment marketplace experience: decide which methods (cards, wallets, BNPL, local payment methods, installments) to surface, where, and for whom, by traveler, market, device, and trip context.
* Improve checkout conversion by removing friction across payment entry, authentication, authorization, error handling, retries, and recovery.
* Build a rigorous experimentation program, from hypothesis and A/B testing through measurement and scaled rollout of winners.
* Define and deliver AI capabilities such as personalized payment recommendations, intelligent routing, failure prediction, next-best-action recovery, and anomaly detection, partnering with Data Science and Engineering on model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and safe rollout.
* Partner with Payments platform teams to ensure reliable, scalable, reusable capabilities across pay-in, authentication, orchestration, and payment status.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insights (conversion, payment and authentication success, support contacts, customer feedback) to prioritize opportunities and measure impact.
Balance traveler experience against cost, authorization performance, fraud and risk, regulatory needs, and operational efficiency, while aligning multiple EG brands and communicating strategy, risks, and decisions to senior leaders.  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* 8 + years of product management experience, with a strong track record building, scaling, or transforming payment products.
* Expert knowledge of the payments ecosystem: payment methods, PSPs, authorization and declines, 3DS, tokenization, wallets, routing, refunds, and failure recovery.
* Proven success designing and optimizing high-converting checkout and payment-selection experiences across web, mobile web, and native apps, using experimentation, analytics, and customer research.
* Experience applying AI/ML to customer-facing products (personalization, decisioning, fraud prevention, optimization), with practical understanding of model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and responsible rollout.
Excellent communication and ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization, with strong analytical skills, product judgment on trade-offs, and a bias toward measurable outcomes.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in travel, ecommerce, marketplaces, fintech, or other high-scale transactional businesses.
* Experience with payment orchestration, merchant-of-record models, payment performance optimization, or payment method expansion.
* Experience taking AI-powered products from problem definition and model evaluation through launch, monitoring, and measurable business impact.
* Familiarity with payment economics (processing costs, FX, rebates, routing, vendor performance) and global delivery across local payment methods, currencies, and regulations.
* Experience building products across multiple brands, regions, or business models, and improving post-booking payment experiences (payment updates, scheduled payments, failure recovery, payment status).

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.
