title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Additional Locations:** India-Haryana, Gurgaon

**Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance**

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

**Location:**

Gurgaon

**About the position:**

Manage the commercial performance of the business from the point of view of revenue, market share and profitability. With additional inputs for strategic and Tactical planning, Project management, Product Life cycle management, Business Analytics, Budgeting and forecasting experience.

**Primary Job Functions:**

  

* Developing and implementing marketing plans for the country according to overall Urology plan and budget.
* Portfolio Strategy & business development planning
* Leading Product Launch and Life Cycle Management in collaboration with sales leadership, local and APAC/global cross-functional stakeholders.
* Analysis of competitor activities, customer needs, technology and infrastructure, therapy adoption etc. and implement Campaigns to drive Portfolio as per division’s goals.
* Engaging with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate and further the achievements of business goals.

**Job Responsibilities**

  

* Strategically managing all aspects of internal and external marketing strategy
* Conceptualize and Lead execution of marketing plans for Urology as per Business goals and budgets, coordinate with internal functions, customers and external service providers, monitor on ground execution of programs/ conferences/ events/ promotions etc the right set of metrics are in place for tracking success.
* Planning and implementing Product launches and Product life cycle management.
* Monitoring sales performance and effectiveness of marketing programs against goals set.
* Product Life cycle management and working with cross functional teams to drive product approvals, inventory planning and product availability as per portfolio marketing plans.
* Conduct analysis of competitor activities, customer needs, technology and infrastructure, therapy adoption
* Development of key marketing communications for portfolio, works closely with agencies and media to develop right messaging and its delivery, tracking the effectiveness of the communication to drive differentiation.
* Establish relationships with KOLs in the field, Drive KOL and customer engagement
* Conduct investigative research to assess brand image, market share and growth opportunities.

**Must Have:**

  

* MBA in marketing
* 5+ Years of exp is required in Medical devices and marketing. Experience of working in marketing / product management function.
* Candidate should have handled some product launches independently
* Strong interpersonal communication skills, written and presentation skills and the ability to manage multiple programs at once and effectively prioritize work are essential.
* Candidate should have experience in Product marketing & Digital marketing
* Proficiency in excel, power point and Microsoft tool
* Candidate with Sales experience or experience in Urology will be a preference but not a limitation
* Experience of working, interacting with KOLs / physicians.
* Experience of working with cross functional teams – finance, sales, regulatory, legal in a corporate environment
* Travel requirement approx. 7-10 days a month.

**Requisition ID:** 637135

Boston Scientific transforms lives through innovative medical technologies that improve the health of patients around the world. As a global medical technology leader for more than 45 years, we advance science for life by providing a broad range of high-performance solutions that address unmet patient needs and reduce the cost of healthcare. Our portfolio of devices and therapies helps physicians diagnose and treat complex cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, oncological, neurological and urological diseases and conditions. Learn more at www.bostonscientific.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

* Provide regular product updates, insights, and recommendations to senior stakeholders and leadership.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
Avam is an applied and materials sciences company developing biology, chemistry, and materials science products for testing, research, manufacturing, and cleaner energy applications. Working at the intersection of science and product development, the team focuses on bringing technically rigorous products to market that support customers across a range of scientific and industrial use cases.

This Product Manager role will help shape how Avam’s scientific product portfolio evolves to meet customer needs and market opportunities. You will work closely with technical and commercial partners to guide product direction, align priorities, and support decisions that balance scientific depth with business impact.

### **Responsibilities**

* Define product strategy and roadmap for Avam’s scientific product portfolio.
* Set priorities for Avam’s products and customer experiences, aligning the work with the organization’s mission and goals.
* Gather input from visitors, staff, and other stakeholders to understand needs and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop clear product plans, goals, and timelines, and keep work moving from idea through launch.
* Coordinate with teams across the organization to plan, deliver, and improve products, programs, or services.
* Define how success will be measured and track results such as customer feedback, participation, revenue, or other agreed-upon goals.
* Use research and performance data to recommend changes and guide future product decisions.
* Manage product budgets, schedules, and competing requests; raise risks or resource needs early.
* Keep stakeholders informed about priorities, progress, decisions, and results.
* Ensure products and experiences are accessible, consistent with Avam’s values, and useful to the people they serve.
* Document product decisions, processes, and lessons learned to support ongoing improvement.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree or higher.
* 4+ years of product management experience in biotechnology or life sciences.
* Experience managing scientific products from discovery through commercial launch.
* Strong ability to translate technical concepts into actionable product requirements.
* Experience with scientific product areas or technical environments such as biotech research tools, diagnostics, lab instrumentation, manufacturing workflows, and cleaner-energy materials applications.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional collaboration across research, engineering, manufacturing, and commercial teams.
* Reliable high-speed internet connection for remote work.

Product Management

Navi Mumbai (On-Site)

Associate, Mid-Senior

3-6 years

Fulltime

  

Job Description

**JD: Associate Product Manager (APM) / Product Manager (PM) | Small Hybrid Vertical**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Department:** Product Management

**Location:** Navi Mumbai

**Reports To:** Senior Product Manager

  
  

### **About Us**

At **ideaForge Technology**, we are pioneering the future of autonomous flight. We design, manufacture, and deploy cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) that solve complex challenges across industries—from defence, homeland security and infrastructure inspection to emergency response and delivery.

  
  

### **Role Summary**

As an Assistant Product Manager (APM) / Product Manager (PM) for the Small Hybrid Verticals portfolio within the Switch UAV family, you will own the product lifecycle, strategy, and market performance for this critical product line. You will report to the Senior Product Manager and operate as a leader within the product management function, bridging customer demand (defense, paramilitary, state agencies) with engineering capability, manufacturing constraints, and regulatory certification requirements.

This role blends strategic product development with hands-on execution across requirements, regulatory alignment (DGCA, FCC, BlueUAS Certification), business planning, and cross-functional team leadership. You will drive the product roadmap from market research through production at scale, managing trade-offs between performance, cost, compliance, and customer needs.

  
  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  
  

### **Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership**

* Develop and execute the multi-year product roadmap for Small Hybrid Verticals. Define product variants, performance tiers, and feature evolution across the Switch family. Work with engineering leadership to balance feature requests, technical feasibility, development timelines, and manufacturing capacity.

* Drive business cases for new initiatives (new variants, payload integrations, airframe configurations). Forecast revenue, unit economics, and market penetration for roadmap milestones.

### **Customer & Market Intelligence**

* Conduct ongoing market research across Indian defense buyers (Army Aviation, BRO, state police, paramilitary forces) and international defense bodies. Translate customer pain points and operational requirements into product requirements documents (PRDs).

* Lead competitive analysis of global and domestic UAV platforms operating in similar tactical niches. Track competitor capabilities, pricing, go-to-market strategies, and certifications.

* Support sales and business development teams with tender responses, feature positioning documents, and pricing justification. Participate in customer demonstrations and technical discussions to validate requirements.

### **Regulatory Certification & Compliance Leadership**

* Own the regulatory certification pathway for Small Hybrid Verticals through DGCA Type Certification and international regulatory bodies (FAA, EASA, etc.). Coordinate with certification teams, external agencies, and technology partners.

* Ensure product design, documentation, and testing align with aviation regulations. Prepare certification-readiness reports and mitigate compliance risks early in the development cycle.

* Manage dependencies with external regulatory bodies and escalate blockers to senior leadership.

### **Cross-Functional Program Leadership**

* Lead integrated product development programs with hardware (airframe, propulsion, avionics), electronics, software, and manufacturing teams. Facilitate requirements clarity, dependency tracking, and milestone achievement.

* Chair product review meetings, design reviews, and launch readiness gates. Escalate technical risks and resolve trade-offs between cost, performance, and timeline.

* Mentor junior product team members and interns. Provide guidance on requirements gathering, market analysis, and business case development.

### **Cost, Pricing & Business Performance**

* Conduct cost-of-goods analysis for Small Hybrid Verticals. Build bottom-up cost stacks including BOM, labor, overhead, and manufacturing yield. Identify cost-reduction opportunities across design, sourcing, and manufacturing.

* Define pricing strategy and margin targets in alignment with MoD procurement patterns, competitive positioning, and profitability objectives.

* Track product P&L, unit economics, and market performance against forecast. Provide monthly/quarterly business reviews to senior leadership.

### **Go-to-Market & Launch Strategy**

* Develop go-to-market plans for new variants or airframe configurations. Define launch messaging, positioning, channel strategy, and customer communication.

* Collaborate with sales, marketing, and customer success to prepare launch materials, data sheets, video content, and training documentation.

* Support contract negotiations and tender responses by providing technical specifications, performance claims, and regulatory compliance documentation.

  
  
  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor''s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication, Systems Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline.

* 3–5 years of product management, program management, or systems engineering experience in hardware-software integrated products (UAVs, aerospace, robotics, automotive, or defense systems).

* Demonstrated experience managing product lifecycle from concept through production, including involvement in design, testing, and field deployment.

* Strong technical aptitude. Ability to understand complex hardware and software architectures, flight dynamics, payload integration, and avionics. Comfortable reading design documentation, block diagrams, and engineering specifications.

* Excellent cross-functional communication skills. Proven ability to align engineering, manufacturing, sales, and leadership around product priorities.

* Analytical and data-driven mindset. Comfortable with financial modeling, cost analysis, and business case development.

* Familiarity with regulatory and certification frameworks (DGCA, FAA, EASA, or similar) and willingness to deepen expertise in aviation regulations.

* Strong organizational and project management skills. Track record of driving initiatives to completion in cross-functional environments.

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Prior experience with UAV, drone, or autonomous systems design and development.

* Familiarity with Indian defense procurement processes, MoD acquisition cycles, and government buyer workflows.

* Experience working in defense, aerospace, or highly regulated hardware sectors.

* Knowledge of avionics, flight control systems, power systems, or payload integration challenges.

* Exposure to Agile or lean product development methodologies.

* Experience with manufacturing, supply chain, or cost optimization initiatives.

Skills

Product Management

Collaboration Building

Program Management

Analytic Problem Solving

Customer Interaction

Regulatory Knowledge

Systems Engineering Process

Data Analytics

* Ensure product design, documentation, and testing align with aviation regulations. Prepare certification-readiness reports and mitigate compliance risks early in the development cycle.

* Manage dependencies with external regulatory bodies and escalate blockers to senior leadership.

### **Cross-Functional Program Leadership**

* Lead integrated product development programs with hardware (airframe, propulsion, avionics), electronics, software, and manufacturing teams. Facilitate requirements clarity, dependency tracking, and milestone achievement.

* Chair product review meetings, design reviews, and launch readiness gates. Escalate technical risks and resolve trade-offs between cost, performance, and timeline.

* Mentor junior product team members and interns. Provide guidance on requirements gathering, market analysis, and business case development.

### **Cost, Pricing & Business Performance**

* Conduct cost-of-goods analysis for Small Hybrid Verticals. Build bottom-up cost stacks including BOM, labor, overhead, and manufacturing yield. Identify cost-reduction opportunities across design, sourcing, and manufacturing.

* Define pricing strategy and margin targets in alignment with MoD procurement patterns, competitive positioning, and profitability objectives.

* Track product P&L, unit economics, and market performance against forecast. Provide monthly/quarterly business reviews to senior leadership.

### **Go-to-Market & Launch Strategy**

* Develop go-to-market plans for new variants or airframe configurations. Define launch messaging, positioning, channel strategy, and customer communication.

* Collaborate with sales, marketing, and customer success to prepare launch materials, data sheets, video content, and training documentation.

* Support contract negotiations and tender responses by providing technical specifications, performance claims, and regulatory compliance documentation.

  
  
  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor''s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication, Systems Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline.

* 3–5 years of product management, program management, or systems engineering experience in hardware-software integrated products (UAVs, aerospace, robotics, automotive, or defense systems).

* Demonstrated experience managing product lifecycle from concept through production, including involvement in design, testing, and field deployment.

* Strong technical aptitude. Ability to understand complex hardware and software architectures, flight dynamics, payload integration, and avionics. Comfortable reading design documentation, block diagrams, and engineering specifications.

* Excellent cross-functional communication skills. Proven ability to align engineering, manufacturing, sales, and leadership around product priorities.

* Analytical and data-driven mindset. Comfortable with financial modeling, cost analysis, and business case development.

* Familiarity with regulatory and certification frameworks (DGCA, FAA, EASA, or similar) and willingness to deepen expertise in aviation regulations.

* Strong organizational and project management skills. Track record of driving initiatives to completion in cross-functional environments.

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Prior experience with UAV, drone, or autonomous systems design and development.

* Familiarity with Indian defense procurement processes, MoD acquisition cycles, and government buyer workflows.

* Experience working in defense, aerospace, or highly regulated hardware sectors.

* Knowledge of avionics, flight control systems, power systems, or payload integration challenges.

* Exposure to Agile or lean product development methodologies.

* Experience with manufacturing, supply chain, or cost optimization initiatives.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager - Domains
job_description:
* R024187

* Pune, Maharashtra, India

* IT Operations

* Regular

  

**Location Details:**India, Remote

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time, others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.

#### **Join our team**

GoDaddy, the world's largest domain name registrar, helps millions of entrepreneurs globally start, grow, and scale their businesses. People come to GoDaddy to name their idea, build a website and logo, sell their products and services, and accept payments. Airo™, our agentic operating system for small businesses, helps entrepreneurs get their idea online, run their business day-to-day, and grow through an integrated identity, presence, and commerce experience.

Domains are where many of those journeys begin. We have over 20 million customers and manage more than 80 million domains. Beyond registration, we run a domain aftermarket for investors and businesses that want to buy or sell a name. **Afternic** is one of the world's largest domain marketplaces, and GoDaddy Auctions is a leading marketplace for expired domains.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll work on a range of customer problems for both independent entrepreneurs getting their business online and domain investors who buy and sell names at scale. Are you interested in this opportunity? We'd love to hear from you!

#### **What you'll get to do...**

* Own and deliver against your squad's Key Results, from problem framing through launch and readout. Learn fast. Ship frequently and set clear assessment criteria before you build
* Stay close to customers. Talk with them, review their feedback, and let their problems set your priorities
* Design and run experiments. Write clear hypotheses, partner with engineering and design to ship quickly, and interpret results honestly. Not every release will produce a statistically significant result. We expect you to find sound ways to measure what's hard to measure, so you know whether a release is moving your goals in the right direction and whether it hurts other key areas
* Use AI as a tool. Apply it to data analysis, UX design iteration, prototyping, and code where it fits, and apply your own judgment to the output
* Partner across time zones with engineering, design, marketing, and support. Communicate clearly in writing and keep decisions visible

#### **Your experience should include...**

* 6+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping measurable results
* Experience running A/B tests or other experiments from hypothesis to decision
* Adaptability and comfort with ambiguity and growth mindset that thrives on learning and continuous improvement – progress over perfection
* Skill in pulling relevant data yourself and interpreting it and practical AI fluency. You can describe where it helped you and where you chose not to rely on it
* Strong written and async communication, and comfort working with teammates that we have in other time zones with a focus on solving customer problems over shipping features

**You might also have...**

* Marketplace experience
* Experience with domains, web presence, or e-commerce
* Experience building for small business owners who are growing online
* Experience with financial or investing tools

*We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.*

**We've got your back...**We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

**About us...** GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us.

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. title: Senior Product Manager (B2B)
job_description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**What you'll do:**

* Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
* You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours?
* You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
* You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
* How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
* integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
* When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.

**What we're looking for:**

* You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
* You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
* You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
* You write, not deck. Specs, trade-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
* You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made

**Experience**

* 5+ years in product in the B2B software industry
* At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
* Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
* Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
* Degree from a top-tier institution, or hands-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

job_description:
Role - Senior Product Manager || Job Location - Bangalore
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Product Manager / Senior Product Manager – AI to lead the strategy, development, and implementation of AI-driven products that transform customer and merchant experiences across our payments ecosystem. The role will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, and Business teams to develop next-generation solutions powered by large language models (LLMs) and other generative AI technologies.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Define and drive the roadmap for generative AI capabilities across our product suite, including fraud detection, customer support automation, and personalised payment experiences.
  
Work cross-functionally with AI/ML Engineers, Data Scientists, UX Designers, and business stakeholders to build, launch, and iterate on AI-powered features.
  
Identify customer pain points and develop AI-first product solutions that improve efficiency, security, and user engagement.
  
Evaluate third-party LLM platforms, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, and work with internal teams to integrate them securely and effectively.
  
Monitor product performance using data and customer feedback, and use insights to optimise AI models and user interactions.
  
Ensure that all AI product developments comply with applicable financial regulations and data privacy laws, including RBI and GDPR requirements.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
5–8 years of product management experience, including at least 1+ year of experience in AI products; experience in payments or fintech is highly preferred.
  
Strong understanding of generative AI models, including LLMs, transformers, and embeddings, and their applications in real-world products.
  
Proven track record of shipping B2C or B2B AI/ML-driven products at scale.
  
Strong analytical, strategic-thinking, and communication skills.
  
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with regulatory sensitivity.
  
  
Nice to Have
  
  
Experience with prompt engineering and fine-tuning LLMs.
  
Background in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Software Engineering.
  
Familiarity with payment ecosystems, risk modelling, and fraud analytics.
  
  
About PayU
  
  
At PayU, we’re building a world without financial borders where everyone can prosper. As a global fintech investor operating in 18+ high-growth markets, we extend financial services to underserved populations, help merchants thrive online, and invest in innovative financial technology. As part of Prosus, one of the world’s largest technology investors, we combine global expertise with local market knowledge to create meaningful impact. Learn more at www.payu.com
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion
  
  
PayU fosters an environment where everyone belongs regardless of gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, or religious belief. Our leadership is committed to creating a transparent, flexible workplace where every voice matters and all PayUneers can succeed. We have zero tolerance for discrimination and actively promote equal opportunities across our global organization.

title: Senior Product Manager - Historian and Visualisation
job_description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, (Workplace & Real Estate Facilities)WREF, CGA (Communications & Government Affairs) and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise. Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.  
  
**Job Purpose:**  
  
The Senior Product Manager - Historian and Visualisation is responsible for the delivery, configuration, support, and continuous improvement of GSK's IP21, A1PE, Historian, reporting, and visualization platforms. The role translates manufacturing, engineering, and operational requirements into technical solutions that enable reliable, secure, compliant, and scalable manufacturing data management. Working with manufacturing sites, (Manufacturing Execution System) MES teams, Engineers, Architects, Quality/Validation, Service teams, and external partners, the Product Engineer designs, configures, integrates, tests, validates, and supports historian and visualization solutions aligned with global standards and product roadmaps. The role manages technical backlogs, supports requirements analysis, coordinates system integrations and data flows, and ensures data integrity, cybersecurity, performance, and platform reliability across the manufacturing technology landscape. Leverage AI-assisted tools to configure, test, and document IP21/A1PE solutions, ensuring all AI-generated outputs are validated for accuracy, data integrity, security, and (Good Practice) GxP compliance prior to release. Deliver reliable historian and visualization solutions that support manufacturing operations and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Own the design of IP21/A1PE solutions and integrations within the approved architecture, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions, making and documenting design decisions, and ensuring alignment with architectural, operational, security, and compliance standards.
* Maintain IP21/A1PE engineering standards and reusable configuration patterns and provide technical guidance and lead engineers to ensure consistent, scalable, and supportable solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders to translate manufacturing, engineering and data requirements into IP21 solutions and improvements, and manage and prioritize the IP21 backlog based on business value, risk, compliance and operational needs.
* Deliver historian capabilities by collaborating with Engineers, Architects, MES teams and vendors.
* Monitor system performance, data quality and user adoption, driving continuous improvement.
* Ensure operational readiness through documentation, training, support and validation activities, and ensure compliance with cybersecurity, data integrity, quality and regulatory requirements.
* Define, test, validate and release IP21 changes, ensuring traceability and compliance, and manage integration and dependencies between IP21, MES, A1PE and other manufacturing systems.
* Support issue resolution, system maintenance and ongoing platform optimization.
* Coordinate supplier activities and leverage data and AI-enabled tools to improve delivery, support and business value
* Use AI-assisted tools as the default way of configuring, scripting, testing and documenting IP21/A1PE changes, and validate all AI-generated output for accuracy, data integrity, security and GxP before release.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience in making technical and product configuration decisions that impact data integrity, operational visibility and business performance, including managing priorities, collaborating with cross-functional teams and delivering historian and visualization solutions that meet reliability, security, compliance and user requirements.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, digital solutions, technology delivery or process-led technology roles.
* Experience in industrial data historian systems (for example, Aspen IP21, A1PE, OSI PI Historian or similar platforms), data visualization platforms and manufacturing reporting solutions within manufacturing, pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical or other regulated environments.
* Experience in developing and supporting real-time dashboards, reports, trends and analytics solutions that enable operational monitoring and decision-making.
* Experience in working with process, production, quality and equipment data from MES, SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), automation, historian and enterprise systems.
* Experience in data analysis, data modelling, data integration and data management for operational and business reporting.
* Experience in configuring and supporting historian and visualization applications, including performance optimisation and troubleshooting.
* Experience in integrating historian and visualization platforms with MES, ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), laboratory and other enterprise systems, including use of industrial connectivity technologies and protocols such as OPC UA (Unified Architecture), OPC HDA (Historical Data Access) or similar standards.
* Experience in SQL (Structured Query Language), databases, reporting tools and data analytics technologies.
* Experience in gathering business requirements and translating them into reporting, dashboard and visualization solutions.
* Experience in working in Agile and cross-functional teams, collaborating with business stakeholders, engineers and support teams.
* Experience in supporting system validation, data integrity, compliance and change management processes in GxP-compliant or other regulated environments.
* Experience in analysing operational data to identify opportunities for process improvement and optimisation.
* Experience in using AI-enabled tools for data analysis, documentation, troubleshooting and decision support, including validating AI-generated outputs, understanding AI limitations and maintaining accountability for data quality, security, GxP compliance and product decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience in written and verbal communication, including explaining product decisions and technology constraints to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience in architecture, integration, data, security, validation, service and operational readiness.
* Experience in organising work, maintaining traceability and applying consistent documentation practices.
* Experience in working across global, cross-functional and supplier teams in a collaborative way.
* Experience in designing and delivering user-centred, capability-led and technology-agnostic solutions.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, API Management, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Containerization, Database Management, High Availability (Inactive), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Microservices Architecture, Network Security, Operating Systems (OS), System Monitors, Version Control System

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**

**The Opportunity**
===================

As a Senior Product Manager on the pricing team, you will help drive topline growth of our hybrid multicloud and AI-ready infrastructure portfolio by driving improvements across the Quote to Cash (Q2C) process to ensure Nutanix software is priced, quoted, and fulfilled seamlessly across channel partners, OEMs, and Cloud Marketplaces.

Tackling challenges that directly impact company revenue, you will secure executive buy-in and guide engineering execution. A pivotal part of this role involves

* Driving enhancements to Salesforce and our CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) platform to deliver a frictionless experience for our sellers and partners.
* Building agentic AI workflows that automate pricing operations and SKU lifecycle management

If you thrive at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Finance, and Go-to-Market and possess sharp business acumen, we want to talk to you.

**About the Team**

At Nutanix, we are simplifying cloud complexity. The Pricing and Monetization Team acts as the commercial compass of the company, defining how our solutions are bundled, priced, and consumed globally across all routes to market.

Operating at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Finance, and Go-to-Market, our work touches almost every function in the company and has a direct, high impact on the company’s top line. We set price points and set discounting policies across geographies and routes to market. We manage the lifecycle of Nutanix pricebooks. We drive continuous enhancements across our Quote to Cash (Q2C) , fulfillment and renewals workflows and platforms to ensure our customers and partners have a great experience buying and using Nutanix products.

We are a highly collaborative, globally distributed team based in India and the US West Coast. We champion a culture of shared learning, absolute project ownership, and deep cross-functional partnership. Above all, we operate with clarity of purpose, transparent communication, and a ruthless focus on delivering results.

**Your Role and responsibilities**
==================================

* Manage SKU lifecycle , pricebook lifecycle and Quote to cash (Q2C) workflows across geographies and routes to market.
* Use AI agents to manage existing workflows and automate new workflows as business needs evolve.
* Drive cross functional alignment with Revenue Operations, Support and Finance and translate business requirements into clearly defined PRDs and use cases.
* Collaborate closely with engineering to ensure requirements are fully understood, technically feasible and delivered accurately.

**What You Will Bring**
=======================

* Proven experience in designing, deploying and managing AI agents and LLM-driven workflows to automate business processes and software testing cycles.
* Deep understanding of B2B sales systems, Quote to Cash (Q2C) process, Enterprise software renewals and SKU lifecycle management.
* 5+ years of relevant professional experience in Product Management, Strategy consulting or building IT systems or business platforms for Enterprise software sales.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills to simplify complex requirements.
* Collaboration with a large number of organizations to align on ideas and execute projects..
* Degree in Business or STEM
* **Work Arrangement**

  **Hybrid****: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.**

title: Senior Product Manager - Engineering, EHS & Sustainability
job_description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**

The Senior Product Manager - Engineering, EHS & Sustainability is accountable for maximising the value of a coherent product family or business capability domain supporting Engineering (asset management and capital projects management), EHS, or Sustainability by translating business strategy, process needs and user outcomes into a clear product vision, roadmap and investment plan. Operating within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Product Domain Lead, the Product Manager balances business value, user experience, technical feasibility, cost, risk, compliance and operational sustainability throughout the product lifecycle.

The Senior Product Manager works closely with Product Owners, Business Process Owners, Architects, Engineers, Service Managers, Data and Cyber Security teams and external partners. The role sets product outcomes and priorities, guides delivery choices and ensures that Product Owners have sufficient strategic context and decision guardrails to manage backlogs and releases effectively. The Product Manager remains accountable for the overall coherence of the product roadmap and for demonstrating that investment is improving business performance, adoption, reliability and user experience.

The role also identifies opportunities for simplification, standardisation, automation and responsible use of data and AI. Recommendations should remain capability-led and technology-agnostic, with solutions selected because they deliver the required outcome and can be integrated, secured, validated, supported and sustained within the enterprise environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with Business Process Owners, functional leaders and users to understand strategic priorities, process pain points and unmet needs and translate these into clear product outcomes.
* Define and maintain the product vision, strategy and roadmap for an assigned product or capability area, aligned to domain strategy and enterprise technology direction.
* Develop outcome-based investment proposals and contribute to business cases by defining value hypotheses, costs, benefits, risks, assumptions, dependencies and measures of success.
* Set prioritisation guardrails for Product Owners and make roadmap trade-offs based on value, cost, urgency, risk, compliance, operational continuity, capacity and technical dependencies.
* Guide Product Owners and delivery teams so that epics, features and releases remain aligned to product outcomes and do not become disconnected collections of requirements.
* Partner with Solution and Enterprise Architects to assess solution options and ensure designs are secure, integrated, scalable, supportable and aligned to architecture and data standards.
* Establish and review product performance measures covering adoption, process outcomes, stability, service effort, user experience, delivery flow and benefit realisation; use insights to adjust priorities.
* Ensure product initiatives comply with required governance for cyber security, data protection, quality, validation, change control, service readiness, continuity and records management.
* Lead product-level vendor and solution evaluations using transparent, capability-led criteria and contribute to commercial decisions, supplier performance reviews and lifecycle planning.
* Manage product risks, technical debt, dependencies and obsolescence, ensuring decisions and escalations are documented and addressed through the appropriate governance forums.
* Drive adoption and operational readiness by ensuring business change, training, support model, documentation, release communications and onboarding needs are reflected in plans.
* Promote iterative, user-centred and data-led ways of working and create a culture focused on measurable outcomes, learning, simplification and continuous improvement.
* Identify and prioritise AI opportunities based on business value, user needs, data readiness, technical feasibility, risk and total cost of ownership.
* Define the product vision, roadmap, outcomes and investment case for AI-enabled capabilities across Engineering, EHS and Sustainability.
* Lead AI initiatives from discovery and experimentation through delivery, adoption, scaling and benefits realisation.
* Define measurable success criteria for AI products, including business outcomes, adoption, user experience, output quality, reliability and operational impact.
* Ensure AI-enabled products meet responsible AI, cybersecurity, privacy, validation, human-oversight and service-readiness requirements.

**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Professional certifications in product management, agile delivery, portfolio management, finance or change leadership are desirable.
* Typically 5+ years of experience in product management, digital transformation, technology delivery, business systems, manufacturing technology, supply chain technology or a related discipline
* Proven experience developing a product vision and roadmap for a product, platform or defined capability area.
* Proven experience in the following business domains:
* Engineering: Plant Maintenance, Calibration, Validation; Content Management, Capital Project Management
* EHS: Incident& Accident Management, Occupational Health, Industrial Hygiene, Chemical Compliance;
* Sustainability: Energy Efficiency, Renewable and Clean Energy, Waste Management
* Experience translating business priorities and user needs into product outcomes, investment proposals and delivery priorities.
* Experience working with Product Owners and cross-functional delivery teams throughout discovery, design, delivery, release, adoption and operation.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on value, cost, risk, compliance, operational impact, resource capacity and technical dependencies.
* Experience defining product measures and using adoption, process, stability, service and user-experience insights to improve performance.
* Experience contributing to business cases, forecasting costs, tracking benefits and supporting funding decisions.
* Experience operating within governance requirements covering architecture, cyber security, data protection, quality, validation, change and service readiness.
* Experience evaluating suppliers or solution options and managing vendor contributions to product outcomes.
* Experience influencing senior functional stakeholders in a global matrix organisation.
* Experience developing product strategies, roadmaps or business cases for AI-enabled, data-driven or advanced analytics products.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams spanning Product, Engineering, Data/ML, Cyber Security, Compliance and business SMEs.
* Experience taking AI-enabled features from discovery and experimentation through release, adoption and scale-up.
* Experience defining value hypotheses, success measures and acceptance criteria for AI use cases.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools, such as Copilot, AI assistants, analytics or experimentation platforms, to support product discovery, backlog refinement and stakeholder communication.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to convert ambiguous business challenges into clear product choices and roadmaps.
* Strong communication, facilitation and influencing skills across business, technical and operational audiences.
* Commercial and financial acumen, including the ability to evaluate cost, value, benefits, risk and total cost of ownership.
* Ability to use data and evidence to challenge assumptions, prioritise investment and evaluate product performance.
* Working understanding of enterprise architecture, integration, data, cyber security, validation, service and operational resilience.
* Ability to create alignment across teams with different objectives, cultures, geographies and levels of technical knowledge.
* Strong judgement, accountability and escalation discipline, with a clear understanding of decision rights.
* Commitment to technology-agnostic, capability-led evaluation and to simple, reusable and supportable solutions.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools in day-to-day product work (e.g. copilot tools, AI assistants, analytics platforms, experimentation tooling) to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience leading cross-functional squads (product, engineering, data/ML, security, compliance) to deliver AI-driven features from discovery through scale-up.
* Strong understanding of generative AI, machine learning, intelligent automation and analytics from a product-management perspective.
* Ability to assess whether a business problem is appropriate for AI or would be better addressed through process simplification, rules, automation or conventional technology.
* Ability to translate Engineering, EHS and Sustainability needs into clear AI product outcomes, use cases and roadmap priorities.
* Understanding of AI-specific product risks, including inaccurate outputs, poor data quality, inappropriate automation, limited explainability and user over-reliance.
* Ability to define and use business, adoption, quality, risk and operational measures to evaluate AI product performance

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager I (Adtech)
job_description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

  
  
**Job Description**

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead products and capabilities that measure national and local television audiences across linear broadcast, cable, and streaming environments. This role sits at the intersection of media measurement, data science, technology, and client needs—turning complex viewing signals into trusted, actionable audience insights for programmers, advertisers, agencies, and other media stakeholders.

The ideal candidate understands how television is bought, sold, distributed, and measured across fragmented platforms. You will define product strategy, translate industry requirements into an actionable roadmap, and guide cross-functional teams from concept through launch and ongoing improvement.

What you’ll do

* Own product strategy and roadmap for cross-platform television audience measurement capabilities spanning national and local markets.
* Translate customer, market, and regulatory needs into clear product requirements, success metrics, and prioritized investments.
* Partner with data science, engineering, research, operations, sales, and customer success to deliver scalable, reliable measurement products.
* Drive measurement solutions across linear and streaming environments, including audience estimates, reach and frequency, impressions, demographic reporting, time-shifted viewing, and deduplicated cross-platform audiences.
* Evaluate the integration and use of viewing data from panels, return-path data, set-top boxes, smart TVs, streaming platforms, and other data sources while maintaining methodological rigor.
* Lead discovery with clients and industry stakeholders to identify unmet needs and validate product direction.
* Define operating models and quality standards that support data accuracy, comparability, transparency, and timely delivery across national and local markets.
* Communicate product vision, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
* Mentor product managers and contribute to stronger product practices, decision frameworks, and team development.

 **Qualifications**

What you bring

* 6+ years of experience in product management, media measurement, audience analytics, advertising technology, streaming, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience taking data-intensive products from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Strong understanding of television and video ecosystems, including broadcast, cable, streaming, connected TV, local markets, ad-supported programming, and media buying.
* Familiarity with audience measurement concepts such as ratings, share, reach, frequency, impressions, demographics, viewing duration, co-viewing, time shifting, and cross-platform duplication.
* Experience working with large-scale data sets, data partnerships, APIs, and/or analytical platforms; comfort partnering deeply with technical teams.
* Ability to balance methodological integrity, customer value, operational feasibility, and commercial priorities.
* Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Experience influencing without direct authority in a matrixed, cross-functional environment.

Success in this role

In the first year, you will establish a clear roadmap for cross-platform television measurement, strengthen alignment between customer needs and delivery teams, and launch improvements that increase trust, usability, and coverage across national and local audiences.

Why join us

You will help shape the next generation of television audience measurement as viewing continues to fragment across traditional and streaming platforms. This is an opportunity to influence an industry-critical product area, work with sophisticated data and technology, and make measurement more transparent, comparable, and useful for the marketplace.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

job_description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few.

Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site (experian.com/careers) to understand why.

**Job Description**
-------------------

As Senior Product Manager, you will lead product strategy and delivery across the Fraud and ID Agent Initiative, from the current MVP through the roadmap toward a scalable, production-ready capability. You will connect client and analyst needs with fraud expertise, data science, engineering, platform, legal, compliance, and AI governance partners. You will own the product outcomes, priorities, and decisions that keep the program useful, safe, and deliverable.

What you will do

* **Set product direction.** Define the product vision, and measurable outcomes for fraud and identity capabilities, balancing the near-term pilot with a reusable longer-term product.
* **Lead discovery with users and partners.** Work with the Brazil pilot partner and fraud specialists to understand analyst workflows, emerging fraud patterns, data needs, and what makes a recommendation actionable and.
* **Coordinate global delivery.** Align the Brazil business and data team with India-based engineering, architecture and platform teams, and partner stakeholders. Establish clear ownership, resolve blockers, and maintain a operating cadence across teams.
* **Guide responsible use of data and AI.** Partner on data access, privacy, security, AI governance, model quality, explainability, auditability, and controls. The current design uses rules and statistical methods to detect patterns, then uses an LLM to explain findings and draft recommendations.
* **Measure product performance.** Define how the team will evaluate detection quality, time to analyst review, fraud outcomes, recommendation usefulness, analyst adoption, and operational impact. Establish validation plans before expanding beyond the pilot.
* **Build the next-phase roadmap.** Use evidence from the pilot to prioritize production readiness, broader data coverage, a purpose-built analyst experience, and future client or regional expansion.
* You will report to the Senior Director of Product Management
* You will have to WFO 2 days a week as its Hybrid working

**Qualifications**
------------------

* You are required to have 8+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex, data-intensive products from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Experience in fraud, identity, payments, financial services, risk decisioning, or a closely related domain.
* Work closely with engineering and data science on data pipelines, model or rules-based systems, integrations, experimentation, and production constraints.
* Strong product judgment: you can turn an ambiguous problem into a focused roadmap, make trade-offs explicit, and connect delivery to customer and business outcomes.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders across regions, functions, and organizational boundaries.

**Preferred experience**

* Building or scaling AI/ML-enabled products, especially human-reviewed decision support or agentic workflows.
* Working with sensitive customer data, privacy or compliance reviews, model governance, and audit requirements.
* Launching products with international teams, pilot partners, or multi-client platforms.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, collaboration, wellness, reward & recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's people first approach is award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2024 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, and Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2024 to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site and Glassdoor to understand why.

Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Recruitment Fraud Awareness - Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.

BenefitsExperian care for employee's work life balance, health, safety and wellbeing. In support of this endeavor, we offer best-in-class family well-being benefits, enhanced medical benefits and paid time off.

title: Senior Product Manager, Data Platform
job_description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

Senior Product Manager, Data Platform

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our consumer data platform. We have a modern cloud lakehouse in place and are now building the consumer data foundation on top of it: a canonical data model, a consumer data warehouse, and one trusted source of data for analytics, data science, risk and finance teams.

You’ll own the roadmap from the start. You’ll decide which use cases to deliver first, define how core consumer entities are modeled, and make sure each new use case builds on shared data instead of one-off pipelines. You’ll work closely with data engineering, data architecture, analytics and risk teams.

*This is not a dashboard-building role. You’ll own the data, definitions and metrics that dashboards, models and reports are built on.*

What you’ll do in your first 12 months

* Build a prioritized backlog of consumer data use cases with analytics, data science, risk and finance, and decide which 3–5 to deliver first.
* Define canonical consumer entities, such as customer, account, transaction, fee, merchant, country and currency, so they mean the same thing across products.
* Decide where products share a common model and where they need their own structures, and document the reasoning.
* Define single, governed definitions for core consumer KPIs such as active customers, revenue per user, lifetime value and churn.
* Write requirements engineers can build from: source-to-target mappings, grain, keys, history rules and data-quality checks.
* Track adoption: which teams have moved to the new models, how much they’re being used, and how many metric discrepancies have been resolved.

Required qualifications

* **Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or an MBA, or equivalent practical experience.**
* **6+ years of product management experience**, including **2+ years in a data product or risk data role**.
* Experience starting with many competing data requests, choosing the few to build first, defining an MVP, and explaining the trade-offs to stakeholders.
* Experience working with engineering to deliver a **data lake/lakehouse, data warehouse or shared data model** used by multiple teams.
* Experience bringing together **inconsistent data from multiple source systems** into common entities, keys and definitions.
* **Hands-on SQL**: you can join across tables, profile data for nulls and duplicates, reconcile counts between systems, and check whether data supports a use case without waiting for an analyst.

Preferred qualifications

* Experience with **consumer payments, digital wallets or fintech**.
* Experience with **payments risk data** such as fraud, account takeover, KYC/AML or transaction monitoring signals.
* Experience with **modern cloud data platforms and tools**, such as Snowflake, Databricks, dbt or major cloud providers’ data services.

**Compensation**
----------------

Estimated Pay Range:  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**
-------------------------------------------

*At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.*  
  
*Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.*  
  
*We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.*

You will own the product outcomes, priorities, and decisions that keep the program useful, safe, and deliverable.

What you will do

* **Set product direction.** Define the product vision, and measurable outcomes for fraud and identity capabilities, balancing the near-term pilot with a reusable longer-term product.

* **Build the next-phase roadmap.** Use evidence from the pilot to prioritize production readiness, broader data coverage, a purpose-built analyst experience, and future client or regional expansion.

* Building or scaling AI/ML-enabled products, especially human-reviewed decision support or agentic workflows.
