job_description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Senior Product Manager - Endpoint Security Cloud Platform** to be part of making that happen.

**Position Overview**

The Senior Product Manager, Endpoint Security Cloud Platform will own the cloud backend capabilities that underpin Arctic Wolf’s Endpoint Security portfolio, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, and agent lifecycle management. Based in Bangalore, India, this is a technical, product-facing role that partners closely with Engineering and Architecture to define requirements, make product decisions, and deliver at scale. The role will be central to two of the team’s most significant initiatives: defining the cloud side of our unified agent strategy, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into a single agent and a single cloud; and planning and executing the migration of several million endpoints from one cloud backend to another.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Ownership – Cloud Platform**

* Own the product definition, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for Endpoint Security cloud backend capabilities, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, multi-tenancy, and agent lifecycle management (deployment, upgrade, and health).

* Translate Endpoint Security strategy into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, partnering with Engineering and Architecture on system design, data flows, APIs, and technical trade-offs.

* Serve as product owner for one or more development teams, owning the definition, prioritization, and hygiene of the backlog from concept through delivery.

* Partner with UX to define administrator and operator workflows that are simple, scalable, and consistent across the Endpoint Security portfolio.

  

**Agent Consolidation & Cloud Migration**

* Define the cloud-side requirements for the unified agent initiative, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into one agent and one cloud, including feature parity, data model alignment, and deprecation sequencing.

* Plan and drive the migration of several million endpoints between cloud backends, including migration strategy, phasing, rollback and risk mitigation, customer and partner impact, and success criteria.

* Work with Engineering, Managed Services, Support, and Customer Success to ensure migrations are seamless for customers, partners, and security analysts.

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as the product point of contact for cloud platform capabilities across Engineering, Security Research, Managed Services, Support, and Customer Success.

* Ensure endpoint cloud capabilities integrate with Arctic Wolf’s broader platform and managed security services, improving analyst workflows, detection and response outcomes, and the customer experience.

* Engage directly with customers, partners, and internal users to gather first-hand requirements, validate solutions, and understand operational challenges at scale.

* Brief Endpoint Security product leadership on roadmap status, delivery plans, and risks, and provide technical input to Product Marketing as needed.

  

**Metrics & Quality**

* Define and track product success metrics for cloud platform capabilities, spanning deployment and adoption, migration progress, platform reliability and performance, product quality, and customer satisfaction.

  

**Key Qualifications**

**Experience & Expertise**

* 5+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years as a product manager at an endpoint security vendor (EPP, EDR, or XDR).

* Demonstrated ownership of a technically complex endpoint security product through multiple stages of its lifecycle, ideally including the cloud management console or backend services that administer endpoint agents.

* Experience working in high-growth organizations with globally distributed product and engineering teams.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  

**Technical Acumen**

* Sufficient technical depth to make product decisions involving endpoint agents, agent-to-cloud communication, device enrollment and identity, policy distribution, telemetry pipelines, and operating-system considerations across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

* Strong understanding of cloud-native SaaS architecture, including multi-tenant services, APIs, microservices, identity and access management, and public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

* Ability to understand customer IT environments, company products, and services at a system, data flow, and API level.

* Hands-on experience with agile development practices and serving as product owner for engineering teams.

  

**Product Skills & EQ**

* Strong decision-making and follow-through, including defining the problem, evaluating alternatives and trade-offs, and measuring results against success criteria.

* Highly detail oriented, with the ability to manage complex dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams.

* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical concepts to engineers, leadership, and customers.

* High EQ and a collaborative approach to partnering across functional teams and time zones.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading large-scale endpoint or cloud migrations, product consolidation, or re-platforming initiatives.

* Experience with device management, enrollment, or provisioning at scale (e.g., MDM/UEM or similar).

* Prior hands-on technical background, such as software engineering, solutions architecture, or sales engineering, before moving into product management.

**On-Camera Policy**

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**

* Hybrid

* Full time

**Who are we?**

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Oracle Cloud Revenue Management (RMCS) Techno-Functional Product Manager with expertise in Oracle RMCS, Subscription Management, Oracle Cloud Finance modules and AI-driven automation solutions. The ideal candidate will partner with business and IT stakeholders to design, implement, enhance, and support revenue management applications while leveraging automation and AI capabilities to improve operational efficiency, business processes, and user experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Oracle RMCS implementation, enhancement, and support initiatives.
* Gather business requirements, perform fit-gap analysis, and design scalable solutions.
* Configure and support Oracle RMCS, Subscription Management, SLA, AR, and GL modules.
* Ensure compliance with ASC 606/IFRS 15 revenue recognition standards.
* Design and support integrations with Oracle Cloud applications and external systems.
* Identify opportunities to leverageAI, automation, and analyticsto improve revenue operations, reporting, and support processes.
* Partner with business and technical teams to implement intelligent workflows, process automation, and AI-enabled solutions.
* Defines test strategy and execution approach to test specific functionality
* Design release scope and schedules aligned with business needs
* Develop test scripts and execute comprehensive test plans and procedures
* Coordinate integration testing, validate test cases with stakeholders for user acceptance testing and training, and secure necessary approvals
* Brings in best practices by keeping up-to-date with technology and vendor products
* Manage defect clarification, triage, and coordinate resolution with engineering teams
* Troubleshoot functional, technical, and integration issues and drive resolution.
* Create and maintain solution documentation, business process flows, and test scenarios.
* Collaborate with global teams and mentor junior team members.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 7+ years of Oracle ERP experience with at least 3 years focused on Oracle RMCS.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle RMCS, Subscription Management, AR, SLA and GL.
* Strong understanding of ASC 606/IFRS 15 revenue recognition principles.
* Experience with FBDI, data conversions and Oracle PL/SQL.
* Experience implementing or supporting AI-driven automation, workflow optimization, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

* Oracle Cloud Financials and/or RMCS Certifications
* Experience with Oracle FDI, Tableau, Salesforce OM, and reporting solutions.
* Experience with AI/ML-based business process automation tools and Oracle AI capabilities.
* Agile/Scrum delivery experience.
* Knowledge of SaaS and subscription-based business models.

job_description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a forward-thinking Digital Product Manager to lead the creation of AI-powered finance technology products that transform enterprise financial data into action. In this role you will define and deliver next-generation finance capabilities that include predictive modelling, trend analysis, risk identification, automated insight generation, and faster anomaly detection across the business,  
  
  
  
  
Working closely with Finance, Accounting, Product and Technology stakeholders, you will translate complex business challenges into scalable digital product solutions that reduce the time from insight to action and enable faster, data-driven decisions that improve financial performance and support profitable growth.

### **Key responsibilities**

* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and success measures for AI-enabled finance technology products across financial management, predictive modelling, insight generation, and anomaly detection.
* Partner with Finance, Accounting, Product and Technology teams to identify high-value business problems and convert them into prioritised product outcomes, requirements, and delivery plans.
* Lead cross-functional delivery of digital products and intelligence capabilities, ensuring solutions use modern data, cloud, analytics, and AI technologies to create measurable business value.
* Translate complex financial data, trends, risks, and opportunities into user-centred products that support faster and more informed decision-making for business leaders.
* Manage stakeholder alignment across senior business and technology audiences, influencing strategy, resolving competing priorities, and maintaining clear communication on progress and outcomes.
* Monitor product performance using agreed metrics, user feedback, and business impact measures to continuously improve adoption, usability, and time from insight to action.

**Essential Skills**

  

* Minimum 15 years’ experience in Digital Product Management, leading platform or data products, from discovery through delivery and adoption.
* Evidence of delivering strategic transformation initiatives that used data, cloud, analytics, automation, or AI technologies to improve business outcomes.
* Strong Finance, Accounting, Data, Analytics, or enterprise technology domain experience, with the ability to translate complex business problems into product roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Experience working with senior business and technology stakeholders to prioritise product backlogs, influence decisions, and deliver outcomes across cross-functional teams.

* Ability to define product success measures and use data, user feedback, and performance indicators to assess value, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Experience delivering AI-powered, machine learning, predictive analytics, or automated insight products within Finance, Accounting, Risk, or enterprise data environments.
* Knowledge of financial performance management, forecasting, scenario modelling, financial controls, or anomaly detection use cases.
* Experience with agile product delivery practices including discovery, roadmap planning, user story definition, backlog management, and iterative release planning.
* Exposure to enterprise data platforms, cloud-based analytics environments, business intelligence solutions, or data governance considerations.
* Product management certification, agile certification, or relevant qualification in business, finance, data, technology, or product management.

**Primary Skills**

Business Case Analyses, Digital Product Management, Product Management, Product Roadmapping, Product Strategies, Systems Thinking

**Shift Time**

**Recruiter Info**

Hiral Parag Rughanihparb@allstate.com

**About Allstate**

**Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.**

The Allstate Corporation is one of the largest publicly held insurance providers in the United States. Ranked No. 84 in the 2023 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations by total revenue, The Allstate Corporation owns and operates 18 companies in the United States, Canada, Northern Ireland, and India. Allstate India Private Limited, also known as Allstate India, is a subsidiary of The Allstate Corporation. The India talent center was set up in 2012 and operates under the corporation's Good Hands promise. As it innovates operations and technology, Allstate India has evolved beyond its technology functions to be the critical strategic business services arm of the corporation. With offices in Bengaluru and Pune, the company offers expertise to the parent organization’s business areas including technology and innovation, accounting and imaging services, policy administration, transformation solution design and support services, transformation of property liability service design, global operations and integration, and training and transition.

Learn more about Allstate India here.

job_description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for GSK's network segmentation product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs, and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.

job_description:
**ABOUT US:**

BYLD Group is committed to making a difference to people and their organizations through its decades of excellence in business solutions, diverse corporate exposure, and skilled workforce. Our clients across various industries believe us in managing, developing, and aligning their corporate needs with their organizational goals and objectives.

Founded in the year 1998, BYLD is the largest group in the South Asian region, offering technology-enabled HR and business productivity solutions. We have served 5,00,000+ individuals, worked with more than 50% of the Fortune 500 and over 60% of the Business World top 1000 companies.

Please read about us – http://byldgroup.com

**Designation -** AGM / GM - Product Manager

**Experience -** 6-8 years

**Location -** Gurgaon, Haryana

**Job Description:**
--------------------

We are looking for an Assistant General Manager / General Manager – Product Management to own BYLD Group's staffing product. The business is operations-heavy, with many internal and client stakeholders. You will use AI and automation to improve how the end-to-end staffing process runs, ship new features, and drive their adoption.

This role carries end-to-end ownership of product outcomes. You will work directly with business stakeholders, engineering and operations, and are expected to design AI-enabled workflows and architecture, prototype them hands-on, and see them through to launch.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

* **Product ownership:** Own the roadmap, prioritization and delivery for the staffing platform, balancing business impact, effort and urgency as priorities change.
* **AI and workflow architecture:** Map the end-to-end staffing workflow, identify where AI and automation add the most value, and define how they are embedded into the platform architecture. Work with engineering on data flow, integrations, accuracy targets, fallbacks and human-in-the-loop checks.
* **Efficiency and automation:** Set measurable targets (turnaround time, recruiter productivity, cost per placement), decide what to build, buy or automate with no-code tools, and prototype quickly before committing engineering time.
* **New features and adoption:** Define and launch new features with operations users, track adoption, close the feedback loop, and retire what is not used.
* **Product opportunities:** Identify gaps across client-facing, candidate-facing and internal workflows and turn them into prioritized, evidence-backed proposals.
* **Stakeholder management:** Run a single intake and triage process for requests from operations, sales, delivery and leadership. Make trade-offs visible and communicate changes early.
* **Requirements and PRDs:** Extract clear requirements from non-technical users and write PRDs that engineering can build against.
* **Sprint execution:** Work with engineering to plan and run sprints, track scope, dependencies and timelines, and unblock issues as they arise.
* **Product operations:** Own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the product function: backlog hygiene, release coordination and checklists, sprint reporting, and regular status updates to stakeholders. Standardize PRD, sprint and release templates so execution stays consistent as the team scales.
* **Metrics and reporting:** Track operational efficiency and product metrics (sprint velocity, release health, feature adoption), analyse NPS, support tickets and feature requests, and report outcomes to leadership.
* **Design collaboration:** Brief the in-house designer, review output against the original ask, and use AI design tools for mock-ups when design support is unavailable.
* **Tooling and onboarding:** Own and maintain the product tooling stack (project management, design, analytics, feedback), keep its data clean, document processes

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 6–8 years in Product Management or Product Operations, ideally in staffing, recruitment tech, HR-tech or other operations-heavy B2B platforms.
* Hands-on product operations experience: backlog management, release coordination, sprint reporting, stakeholder status updates, and building templates and processes that scale.
* Proven ability to improve operational efficiency with AI and automation, with measurable results (hours saved, turnaround time reduced).
* Clear understanding of how to embed AI into a product architecture: where LLMs, OCR and document intelligence, and rules-based automation each fit, how to measure accuracy, and how to design fallbacks.
* Hands-on builder: you create working automations, agents or prototypes yourself with LLM, workflow or AI coding tools.
* Strong stakeholder management across many senior stakeholders with conflicting priorities, and comfort with rapid change.
* Ability to map operational workflows, find bottlenecks and convert them into product requirements.
* Experience writing PRDs and working with engineering through the sprint cycle.
* Experience launching features and driving adoption using product analytics and user feedback.
* Comfortable working with designers: clear briefs and structured feedback.
* Structured, detail-oriented approach to documentation, and excellent written and verbal communication.

**Technical Requirements:**
---------------------------

* **AI architecture:** LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval (RAG), agents, evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design, plus cost, latency and data privacy trade-offs.
* **Workflow and integration tools:** n8n, Zapier, Make or similar; APIs, webhooks and integrations with ATS, CRM and VMS systems.
* **AI coding tools:** Active working knowledge of Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to prototype, debug or ship small changes independently.
* **Architecture basics:** APIs, databases, queues and how web and mobile applications are built, enough for informed conversations with engineering.
* **Product and project management:** Jira, Linear, Asana, Trello or similar; Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace.
* **Design and prototyping:** Figma (or similar) and AI design tools such as Figma AI or Uizard.
* **Analytics and reporting:** Mixpanel, Amplitude or Google Analytics dashboards; strong Excel / Sheets.

**Designation -** AGM / GM - Product Manager

**Job Description:**
--------------------

We are looking for an Assistant General Manager / General Manager – Product Management to own BYLD Group's staffing product. The business is operations-heavy, with many internal and client stakeholders. You will use AI and automation to improve how the end-to-end staffing process runs, ship new features, and drive their adoption.

This role carries end-to-end ownership of product outcomes. You will work directly with business stakeholders, engineering and operations, and are expected to design AI-enabled workflows and architecture, prototype them hands-on, and see them through to launch.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

* **Product ownership:** Own the roadmap, prioritization and delivery for the staffing platform, balancing business impact, effort and urgency as priorities change.
* **AI and workflow architecture:** Map the end-to-end staffing workflow, identify where AI and automation add the most value, and define how they are embedded into the platform architecture. Work with engineering on data flow, integrations, accuracy targets, fallbacks and human-in-the-loop checks.
* **Efficiency and automation:** Set measurable targets (turnaround time, recruiter productivity, cost per placement), decide what to build, buy or automate with no-code tools, and prototype quickly before committing engineering time.
* **New features and adoption:** Define and launch new features with operations users, track adoption, close the feedback loop, and retire what is not used.
* **Product opportunities:** Identify gaps across client-facing, candidate-facing and internal workflows and turn them into prioritized, evidence-backed proposals.
* **Stakeholder management:** Run a single intake and triage process for requests from operations, sales, delivery and leadership. Make trade-offs visible and communicate changes early.
* **Requirements and PRDs:** Extract clear requirements from non-technical users and write PRDs that engineering can build against.
* **Sprint execution:** Work with engineering to plan and run sprints, track scope, dependencies and timelines, and unblock issues as they arise.
* **Product operations:** Own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the product function: backlog hygiene, release coordination and checklists, sprint reporting, and regular status updates to stakeholders. Standardize PRD, sprint and release templates so execution stays consistent as the team scales.
* **Metrics and reporting:** Track operational efficiency and product metrics (sprint velocity, release health, feature adoption), analyse NPS, support tickets and feature requests, and report outcomes to leadership.
* **Design collaboration:** Brief the in-house designer, review output against the original ask, and use AI design tools for mock-ups when design support is unavailable.
* **Tooling and onboarding:** Own and maintain the product tooling stack (project management, design, analytics, feedback), keep its data clean, document processes

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 6–8 years in Product Management or Product Operations, ideally in staffing, recruitment tech, HR-tech or other operations-heavy B2B platforms.
* Hands-on product operations experience: backlog management, release coordination, sprint reporting, stakeholder status updates, and building templates and processes that scale.
* Proven ability to improve operational efficiency with AI and automation, with measurable results (hours saved, turnaround time reduced).
* Clear understanding of how to embed AI into a product architecture: where LLMs, OCR and document intelligence, and rules-based automation each fit, how to measure accuracy, and how to design fallbacks.
* Hands-on builder: you create working automations, agents or prototypes yourself with LLM, workflow or AI coding tools.
* Strong stakeholder management across many senior stakeholders with conflicting priorities, and comfort with rapid change.
* Ability to map operational workflows, find bottlenecks and convert them into product requirements.
* Experience writing PRDs and working with engineering through the sprint cycle.
* Experience launching features and driving adoption using product analytics and user feedback.
* Comfortable working with designers: clear briefs and structured feedback.
* Structured, detail-oriented approach to documentation, and excellent written and verbal communication.

**Technical Requirements:**
---------------------------

* **AI architecture:** LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval (RAG), agents, evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design, plus cost, latency and data privacy trade-offs.
* **Workflow and integration tools:** n8n, Zapier, Make or similar; APIs, webhooks and integrations with ATS, CRM and VMS systems.
* **AI coding tools:** Active working knowledge of Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to prototype, debug or ship small changes independently.
* **Architecture basics:** APIs, databases, queues and how web and mobile applications are built, enough for informed conversations with engineering.
* **Product and project management:** Jira, Linear, Asana, Trello or similar; Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace.
* **Design and prototyping:** Figma (or similar) and AI design tools such as Figma AI or Uizard.
* **Analytics and reporting:** Mixpanel, Amplitude or Google Analytics dashboards; strong Excel / Sheets.

----------------

* Experience with ATS, CRM or VMS platforms and the staffing lifecycle.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in “Data Product Ownership, AI Automation, and Data Quality Engineering”. You have found the right team.

As “Data Product Ownership, AI Automation, and Data Quality Engineering Professional / Lead” within our “Asset & Wealth Management – MPX Account Management Services (Account SOR)” , you will be responsible for setting and improving our organizational objectives, and ensuring their consistent accomplishment.

Job Responsibilities

* **Lead** the Operate function for Account Management Services by owning day-to-day product stability, service delivery, and BAU point-of-contact coverage.
* **Partner** with stakeholders across Operations, Technology, and Service Management to triage, prioritize, and resolve tickets, incidents, defects, and urgent ad-hoc requests with clear SLAs and communications.
* **Translate** recurring BAU issues and user feedback into product enhancements by defining requirements, acceptance criteria, and release plans to improve user/client experience.
* **Establish** operating rhythms and performance metrics (e.g., ticket trends, root-cause themes, time-to-resolution) to drive continuous improvement and proactive risk/controls management.
* **Define** crisp problem statements, use cases, user journeys, success metrics, and acceptance criteria from complex requirements to enable fast, rigorous delivery.
* **Drive** the modernization roadmap across platform evolution, user experience improvements, and scalable operational processes.
* **Identify** AI and Agentic AI opportunities that increase straight-through processing and data quality with safe, explainable, and governable designs.
* **Partner** across Business, Operations, Technology, and Controls to remove blockers, force decisions, and accelerate delivery outcomes.
* **Sequence** work across teams, platforms, and release trains to manage dependencies and deliver predictable, high-quality releases.
* **Stand up** delivery and outcome metrics (quality, timeliness, adoption, STP lift, defect reduction, cycle time) to continuously reshape priorities and the roadmap.
* **Own** the product vision, roadmap, and execution for mission-critical data services powering onboarding, reporting, operational workflows, and investment processes.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

* **Demonstrate** a proven track record as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Delivery Lead for data products, platforms, or critical enterprise services (ideally in a major financial institution).
* **Bring** a minimum of 10 years of Financial Services experience blending data, technology, and operations with Asset & Wealth Management data concepts.
* **Deliver** effectively in agile environments with backlog discipline, pragmatic scope control, and outcome-based execution.
* **Work** hands-on with SQL and Python to navigate large datasets, validate hypotheses, investigate issues, and partner credibly with engineering and analytics.
* **Apply** practical fluency with AI and Agentic AI for data products (e.g., reconciliations, anomaly detection, triage, metadata enrichment, exception handling, workflow orchestration) while evaluating value, risk, scalability, and controls.
* **Influence** stakeholders at every level with sharp written and verbal communication suitable for governance forums and senior leadership.
* **Hold** a minimum of a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, or a related field.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

* **Bring** Asset Management experience with onboarding and servicing.
* **Use** foundational AI/developer tooling such as VS Code and GitHub Copilot within a modern engineering environment.
* **Show** familiarity with data-quality tooling, metadata platforms, lineage frameworks, and modern data platforms (lakehouse/warehouse patterns, distributed processing, APIs, and data services).
* **Earn** product management certifications such as CSPO or PSPO (preferred).
* **Hold** a Master's degree in engineering or computer science and demonstrate a creative mindset for innovative data-solution design.

Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

title: Senior Principal - Product Owner - EUC/MDM
job_description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
Own the product for how 50,000+ employees across [X] countries get, use and are supported on their devices — with particular depth on the mobile estate: iOS and Android, corporate-owned and BYOD, standard knowledge-worker devices and the field, clinical, lab and manufacturing devices that behave nothing like them.

This is a product role, not a project role. The Senior Product Owner owns the vision, the backlog and the outcomes — deciding what gets built and why, in what order, and being accountable for whether it actually improved anything. Success is measured in adoption, effort saved and experience improved, not in tickets closed or features shipped.

The role sits between three constituencies that rarely agree: employees who want their devices to just work, Security who want them locked down, and Finance who want them cheaper. Turning that tension into a prioritised, defensible backlog is the core of the job.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and articulate the product vision for end user services and mobile device management — a clear statement of what the service will be in 18 months and why that matters to the business.
* Maintain a rolling roadmap that balances new capability, technical debt, security and compliance obligations, and experience improvement; keep it honest about capacity.
* Translate the EUC strategy and architecture direction into a sequenced, deliverable product backlog.
* Own the business case and benefits realisation for product investment; be accountable for the value claimed, not just the spend approved.
* Own, refine and prioritise the product backlog as the single source of truth for the squad; make prioritisation calls transparently and defend them.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from and testers can verify — specific about the outcome, not prescriptive about the solution.
* Lead sprint planning, refinement, review and retrospective alongside the Scrum Master; accept or reject work against acceptance criteria.
* Manage dependencies across adjacent squads — identity, security, networking, service management — and escalate early when they threaten delivery.

title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
We are seeking a proactive and client-focused Associate Product Manager to support the delivery and continuous improvement of web and mobile-based sports technology products. The role will act as a bridge between the client and the central Product, Engineering, Design, and QA teams based in Delhi, ensuring that client requirements, feedback, and business priorities are clearly understood and translated into actionable product work.

The candidate will coordinate with client stakeholders, conduct product demonstrations and feature walkthroughs, gather requirements, explain proposed solutions, and track requested changes from discussion through delivery. The role also involves contributing to the definition and development of product modules by preparing workflows, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.

The Associate Product Manager will work closely with internal teams to clarify requirements, monitor development progress, manage dependencies, coordinate testing and UAT, and support releases. The ideal candidate combines strong communication and coordination skills with structured product thinking and the ability to take ownership of tasks across the product lifecycle.

**Responsibilities:**

Act as the primary coordination bridge between client stakeholders and the central Product, Engineering, Design, and QA teams in Delhi.

Conduct product demos, feature walkthroughs, and review sessions; explain existing functionality and proposed enhancements clearly to clients.

Gather, analyse, and document client requirements, feedback, change requests, and suggestions; clarify scope, priorities, and expected outcomes.

Translate requirements into product workflows, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and screen- level/module documentation.

Contribute to building and improving product modules by defining user journeys, business rules, edge cases, and expected system behaviour in coordination with design and development teams.

Coordinate with internal teams on sprint planning inputs, task tracking, dependencies, delivery timelines, risks, and follow- ups.

Support product testing, UAT planning and coordination, issue logging, validation of fixes, and sign-off with relevant stakeholders.

Maintain product documentation such as PRDs, requirement documents, meeting notes, decision logs, release notes, and knowledge-transfer materials.

Share regular status updates with clients and internal stakeholders, including progress, open questions, risks, and upcoming milestones,

Support product rollouts, client onboarding, training, feedback collection, and post-release improvement activities.

**Measurable Outcomes / Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The Associate Product Manager will be evaluated against the following measurable outcomes, considering agreed project scope, timelines, dependencies, and factors within the role's control.

**Requirement Quality & Clarity:** 100% of requirements and change requests are documented with the business objective, scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and expected outcome before handover for development. Requirement Sign-off & Traceability: Maintain documented client decisions and approvals for all the requirements and changes, with traceability from the original request through development, testing, and closure. UAT Coordination & Closure: Coordination of planned UAT cycles and document test scenarios, feedback, defects, and sign-offs. Track all identified issues until closure or a documented decision/acceptance of pending items.

**Delivery Tracking & Follow-up:** Maintain an up-to-date tracker for all the assigned requirements, enhancements, and change requests, including owner, status, target date, dependencies, and risks. Escalate blockers and material timeline deviations promptly.

**Documentation & Product Readiness:** Ensure relevant product documentation (workflows, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, meeting/decision logs, and release notes, as applicable) is prepared for all the assigned features at the relevant development or release milestone.

**Stakeholder Communication:** Provide status updates at the agreed reporting frequency. Circulate meeting minutes, decisions, action items, owners, and due dates within one working day of each stakeholder meeting.

**Product Demonstrations & Feedback Management:** Conduct all product demos and feature walkthroughs. Log client feedback and action items, and track each item to resolution, prioritisation, or a documented next step. Change Request Management: Log client change requests and ensure each has a documented assessment of scope and dependencies, status, priority/decision, and next step before implementation commitments are communicated. Cross-functional Coordination: For all assigned tasks requiring cross-functional input, identify owners, dependencies, and follow-up actions; escalate blockers within the agreed project escalation process.

**Module Development & Release Support:** Support assigned modules and enhancements through requirements definition, development coordination, testing, UAT, and release readiness, with deliverables checked against agreed acceptance criteria before closure.

Performance will be reviewed periodically against these KPIs using documented deliverables, agreed project timelines, client feedback, and internal stakeholder reviews. Targets should be assessed in the context of project scope, dependencies, and factors within the role's control.

**Required Skills & Traits**

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or a related discipline.

4-8 years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, implementation, client coordination, or a related role; experience in a contractual or client-facing delivery environment is useful.

Good understanding of web and mobile application ecosystems and the product development lifecycle.

Familiarity with tools such as JIRA, Zoho Sprints, Trello, or equivalent for backlog and task tracking.

Ability to understand user journeys and translate business needs into clear workflows, requirements, and module-level specifications; exposure to Figma or wireframing.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritisation, and requirement clarification skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence in conducting product demos and client discussions.

Ability to coordinate effectively across clients and cross-functional teams, follow up on open items, and manage competing priorities.

High ownership, attention to detail, adaptability, and a structured approach to documentation and execution.

Ability to understand technical concepts such as APIs, integrations, data flows, and system dependencies is an advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience working with digital products, SaaS platforms, enterprise systems, or sports technology products.

Experience preparing PRDs, BRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, or other product/business analysis documentation.

Exposure to client demos, requirement workshops, UAT, implementation, onboarding, or change-request management.

Basic understanding of Agile/Scrum practices, sprint cycles, release planning, and software testing.

Interest in sports, fitness, athlete management, event operations, or other sports-tech use cases is desirable.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose**

The Associate Director - Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability is responsible for maximising the value of a specific Product by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Senior Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability guides Product Analysts and works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead.
* Co-create the product vision and roadmap with the business and own the value case, including the expected benefits and how they are measured.
* Own and manage the Product backlog, ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
* Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the Product Manager or Product Domain Lead (clear RACI boundary).
* Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Product Analysts and working with Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
* Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes follow required security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.
* Shape design trade-offs with Solution Architects, and scout emerging capability on the product platforms, bringing a short ranked opportunity list into backlog refinement.
* Act as an escalation point for the Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by the Product Manager and Domain Lead.
* Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile, iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact.
* Own and prioritise the AI product backlog, translating Engineering, EHS and Sustainability needs into clear AI use cases, epics, features and acceptance criteria.
* Define the business value and success measures for AI use cases, including adoption, user experience, process improvement, quality, risk reduction and support effort.
* Lead AI-enabled product delivery across business stakeholders, engineers, architects, data specialists, security, quality and third-party providers.
* Ensure responsible and compliant use of AI, including appropriate human oversight, data protection, security, validation, traceability and regulated change controls.
* Monitor AI product performance after release, using operational metrics, user feedback and evaluation results to identify improvement priorities.

**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* Typically 5+ years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
* Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
* Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.
* Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices.
* Experience owning or delivering an AI, Generative AI, advanced analytics or intelligent automation product.
* Experience translating business problems into prioritised AI use cases, product requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Experience leading cross-functional delivery involving business SMEs, architects, engineers, data teams, security and compliance functions.
* Experience defining and monitoring AI product KPIs, evaluation criteria, adoption measures and benefits realisation.
* Experience delivering technology products in a regulated or highly controlled environment, with appropriate governance, validation and change control.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions.
* Skilled in coaching and guiding Product Analysts and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations.
* Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.
* Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant.
* Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately.
* AI product management: Ability to identify, assess and prioritise AI use cases based on business value, feasibility, data availability, risk and cost.
* Generative AI understanding: Good working knowledge of large language models, Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents and human-in-the-loop solutions.
* AI evaluation: Ability to define acceptance criteria and performance measures covering accuracy, relevance, consistency and user value.
* Responsible AI and risk management: Understanding of privacy, security, transparency, human oversight and risks such as unsupported or misleading outputs
* Stakeholder communication: Ability to explain AI capabilities, limitations and trade-offs clearly to business and technology stakeholders.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Process Diagrams, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Principal - Product Owner - EUC/MDM
job_description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Own the product for how 50,000+ employees across [X] countries get, use and are supported on their devices — with particular depth on the mobile estate: iOS and Android, corporate-owned and BYOD, standard knowledge-worker devices and the field, clinical, lab and manufacturing devices that behave nothing like them.

This is a product role, not a project role. The Senior Product Owner owns the vision, the backlog and the outcomes — deciding what gets built and why, in what order, and being accountable for whether it actually improved anything. Success is measured in adoption, effort saved and experience improved, not in tickets closed or features shipped.

The role sits between three constituencies that rarely agree: employees who want their devices to just work, Security who want them locked down, and Finance who want them cheaper. Turning that tension into a prioritised, defensible backlog is the core of the job.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and articulate the product vision for end user services and mobile device management — a clear statement of what the service will be in 18 months and why that matters to the business.
* Maintain a rolling roadmap that balances new capability, technical debt, security and compliance obligations, and experience improvement; keep it honest about capacity.
* Translate the EUC strategy and architecture direction into a sequenced, deliverable product backlog.
* Own the business case and benefits realisation for product investment; be accountable for the value claimed, not just the spend approved.
* Own, refine and prioritise the product backlog as the single source of truth for the squad; make prioritisation calls transparently and defend them.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from and testers can verify — specific about the outcome, not prescriptive about the solution.
* Lead sprint planning, refinement, review and retrospective alongside the Scrum Master; accept or reject work against acceptance criteria.
* Manage dependencies across adjacent squads — identity, security, networking, service management — and escalate early when they threaten delivery.
* Own the release and change approach for user-visible change, including pilot rings, communications and rollback triggers.
* Be the voice of the employee in every prioritisation conversation, and hold the evidence to back it: research, telemetry, ticket analysis and direct observation.
* Run continuous discovery — user interviews, shadowing in the field and on the shop floor, surveys, usability testing — with the populations who are least like head office.
* Convert digital experience (DEX) telemetry and service desk data into prioritised, root-cause-addressing backlog items; treat every recurring ticket category as a product defect until proven otherwise.
* Own adoption: define what good adoption looks like before launch, measure it after, and act when it does not materialise.
* Own the product for the mobile estate: enrolment and provisioning experience, BYOD vs. corporate-owned models, app catalogue and distribution, and the employee-facing side of mobile security policy.
* Own the BYOD proposition end to end — the privacy commitment, the employee terms, the enrolment journey and the trust that makes people willing to participate.
* Manage the mobile OS release cycle as a recurring product event: annual iOS and Android major releases, beta assessment, compatibility validation and controlled rollout.
* Own the product relationship with mobile carriers, MDM platform vendors and app suppliers.
* Build and maintain relationships across business units, regions and functions; run a stakeholder forum or product council that makes trade-offs visible rather than fought in private.
* Partner with Cyber Security to land control changes in ways employees will accept and comply with — security outcomes delivered through good product design rather than mandate.
* Engage works councils, employee representatives and Privacy where mobile telemetry, BYOD or device monitoring is in scope.
* Report on product performance to senior stakeholders in outcome terms.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.
* Product ownership certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe POPM, Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), ITIL v4 Foundation, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator Associate).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Product ownership at scale for end user services and mobile device management, with direct working familiarity with an enterprise MDM/UEM platform (e.g., Microsoft Intune).
* Mobile estate strategy across iOS and Android, corporate-owned and BYOD, standard knowledge-worker devices and specialised field, clinical, lab and manufacturing devices.
* Digital employee experience (DEX) and service-desk-driven product improvement, using telemetry and ticket analysis to prioritise root-cause fixes.

**Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and 12+ years in technology delivery, including 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager with genuine backlog authority (not a business analyst writing another team's requirements).
* Product or service ownership serving 10,000+ users across multiple countries.
* Demonstrable hands-on product experience in end user computing, digital workplace or mobile device management — including direct familiarity with an enterprise MDM/UEM platform.
* Sustained experience owning a backlog for a cross-functional agile squad, through multiple release cycles, in a scaled delivery environment.
* Track record of using user research and quantitative telemetry to drive prioritisation, with a specific example of a decision the data changed.
* A demonstrable product outcome delivered and measured — adoption, experience, effort or cost — not merely a feature shipped.
* Proven ability to manage senior and conflicting stakeholders across business units and regions, and to hold a prioritisation decision under pressure.
* Fluent English; credible with both engineers and executives in a global matrixed organisation.
* Willingness to travel internationally, approximately [10–15]% of the time — including to sites, labs and field locations where the devices are actually used.
* Desirable:
* Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — including GxP-validated systems and the change control that comes with them.
* Product ownership for specialised or frontline mobile devices: rugged handhelds, lab and clinical devices, field-force tablets, shared/kiosk devices, scanners and shop-floor endpoints.
* Experience with deskless and frontline worker populations — employees without a corporate laptop, whose primary device is shared or personal.
* Works council and employee-representation engagement, particularly on BYOD, mobile telemetry and device monitoring.
* Mobile app product experience — internal app store curation, in-house mobile app lifecycle, MAM policy design.
* Experience delivering a major platform migration or transition as a product owner — MDM platform change, MSP transition, or BYOD programme launch.
* Service design or UX research background; journey mapping and service blueprinting.
* Carrier and telecom management — mobile contracts, eSIM, international roaming, expense management.
* AI-enabled workplace tooling product experience — Copilot, virtual agents, AI-assisted support deflection.
* Accessibility and assistive technology as a designed-in part of the device proposition.
* Sustainability — device longevity, refurbishment and circular IT built into the product roadmap.

**Skills/Background**

* Deep product craft across backlog ownership, outcome-based requirements, continuous discovery, and value definition and measurement.
* Endpoint management platform fluency (Microsoft Intune or comparable MDM/UEM tooling) — enough to have credible conversations with engineers and challenge estimates.
* Understanding of endpoint security fundamentals — conditional access, compliance policy, encryption — and the trade-offs each imposes on the user.
* Fluency in agile delivery tooling (Azure DevOps, Jira, ServiceNow) — able to run a backlog others can actually read.
* Influence without authority — landing decisions across engineering, security, service delivery, regions and vendors through evidence and relationship.
* Communication — equally credible in a sprint refinement and in a steering committee; able to translate technical constraint into business consequence.
* Comfort with conflict — the role exists at the intersection of security, cost and experience, and someone is always disappointed.
* Bias to evidence — willing to change position when the data contradicts a strongly held view, including their own.

**Skills**

Agile Leadership, Agile Management, Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, GxPs, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Process Diagrams, Product Ownership, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

job_description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**

The Product Owner is responsible for maximising the value, compliance, adoption, and operational performance of the LabWare Lab Execution System (LES) used to digitise and control QC laboratory test execution. The role translates QC, Quality, site, and regulatory needs into a prioritised LabWare LES backlog and leads delivery across the product lifecycle within strategic, financial, architectural, and GxP guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead. The Product Owner works closely with laboratory stakeholders, Quality, CSV, Tech, suppliers, and delivery teams to ensure LabWare LES capabilities are usable, validated, secure, supportable, inspection-ready, and aligned to standardised laboratory execution processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with QC laboratory, Quality, site, and digital stakeholders to understand laboratory execution needs and define LabWare LES outcomes that improve compliance, data integrity, analyst experience, and operational efficiency.
* Own and manage the LabWare LES product backlog, ensuring epics, features, user stories, configuration needs, master data impacts, reporting requirements, validation expectations, and dependencies are clearly defined and prioritised.
* Make backlog prioritisation decisions based on GxP impact, business value, laboratory criticality, data integrity risk, defect severity, release capacity, cost, and cross-site standardisation opportunities, escalating strategic trade-offs to the Product Manager or Product Domain Lead.
* Lead delivery activities for LabWare LES changes, guiding Product Analysts, configuration specialists, testers, CSV resources, architects, engineers, and supplier teams to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, validated, secure, supportable, and aligned to architecture and quality standards.
* Ensure LabWare LES changes support controlled laboratory execution, including electronic worksheets, procedural step guidance, calculations, specifications, instrument or system interfaces, review-by-exception, audit trails, electronic signatures, and exception handling where applicable.
* Drive operational readiness by ensuring support model impacts, SOP updates, training materials, release communications, cutover plans, hypercare, runbooks, and knowledge transfer are in place before deployment.
* Maintain product performance measures for LabWare LES, including adoption, release throughput, defects, incident trends, validation progress, user experience signals, support effort, and benefits realisation; use insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes comply with GxP, CSV, data integrity, security, privacy, access control, change control, and supplier governance expectations, obtaining input and approvals from Quality, CSV, Security, Architecture, and other SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects and technical teams in assessing design options, integrations, environment management, reporting, performance, and dependencies with LIMS, instruments, ERP, document management, identity management, and other connected systems.
* Act as an escalation point for LabWare LES functional issues, defects, prioritisation conflicts, and release readiness decisions, balancing business continuity, compliance risk, user impact, and delivery capacity.
* Promote agile, iterative, value-driven delivery practices while maintaining the discipline required for validated systems, including traceability from requirements through design, build, testing, approval, release, and ongoing periodic review.

**Basic Requirements:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Life Sciences or related field (or equivalent experience).

* Typically 5+ years of experience in product delivery, laboratory informatics, LabWare LIMS / LES, QC laboratory systems, or process-led technology roles in a regulated environment.
* Proven experience defining, prioritising, and delivering requirements for laboratory execution, LIMS / LES, electronic worksheets, analytical workflows, reporting, interfaces, or validated laboratory systems.
* Experience working directly with QC laboratories, Quality, CSV, IT, suppliers, and site stakeholders to translate laboratory needs into feasible, compliant, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on GxP impact, data integrity risk, user impact, business continuity, technical complexity, cost, and delivery capacity.
* Experience supporting validated system delivery, including requirements, configuration, testing, defect triage, release readiness, change control, and deployment into controlled laboratory environments.
* Familiarity with regulated change management, periodic review, audit trail review expectations, user access governance, supplier management, and quality documentation for GxP systems.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches that simplify laboratory processes, reduce manual transcription, improve right-first-time execution, and increase adoption of standardised digital laboratory ways of working.
* Experience working within agile or hybrid delivery environments while maintaining appropriate validation, traceability, and release controls for regulated systems.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Process Diagrams, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
